text.ar:
— ٣٨٨ —

وَأَنْتَ تَرُشُّ عَلَى الزُّهْرَةِ وَهِيَ دَائِرَةٌ قَلِيلًا وَأَنْتَ تَسُوطُهَا تَنْزِلُ الْأَوْقِيَةُ ٤ دَرَاهِمَ
(فَصْلٌ) فِي ذِكْرِ الْعَقَاقِيرِ وَهِيَ ٣ أَنْوَاعٍ تُرَابِيَّةٍ وَنَبَاتِيَّةٍ وَحَيَوَانِيَّةٍ فَالْتُرَابِيَّةُ ٦ أَنْوَاعٍ أَرْوَاحٍ وَأَجْسَادٍ
وَأَحْجَارٍ وَزَاجَاتٍ وَأَمْلَاحٍ وَبَوَارِقَ فَالْأَرْوَاحُ ٤ الزِّئْبِقُ وَالنَّشَادِرُ وَالْكِبْرِيتُ وَالزَّرْنِيخُ وَالْأَجْسَادُ
٧ الذَّهَبُ وَالْفِضَّةُ وَالنُّحَاسُ وَالْحَدِيدُ وَالرَّصَاصُ وَالْقَصْدِيرُ وَالْخَاصِّينَ مِنَ الْأَحْجَارِ ١٦ الْمَرْقَشِيثَا
وَالْمَغْنِيسَا وَالرَّوْضُ وَاللَّازَوَرْدُ وَالرَّهَنْجُ وَالدِّيزَوَرْجُ وَالشَّاذَنْجُ وَالشَّكُّ وَالْكُحْلُ وَالطَّلْقُ وَالْحِبْسُ
وَالزَّاجُ وَالزَّاجَاتُ وَالْقَلْقَنْدُ وَالْقَلْقَطَارُ وَالسُّورِيُّ وَالْبَوَارِقُ ٦ بُورَقُ الْحِبْرِيِّ وَبُورَقُ الصَّاغَةِ
وَالتِّسْكَارُ وَالْبُورَقُ الْأَحْمَرُ وَبُورَقُ الرَّاوَنْدِ وَبُورَقُ الْغَرْبِ ٤ لَأَمْلَاحُ ١١ الْمِلْحُ الطِّيبُ وَالْمُرُّ
وَالطَّرْزَدُ وَالْأَنْدَرَانِيُّ وَالنِّفْطِيُّ وَالْهِنْدِيُّ وَالْعَيْنِيُّ وَمِلْحُ الرَّمَادِ فِيهِمْ طَبِيعِيَّاتٌ مَصْنُوعَاتٌ مَعْرُوفَةٌ
أَلْوَانُهَا وَأَجْوَدُهَا أَرْوَاحُ الزِّئْبِقِ الَّذِي يَكُونُ رَقِيقًا أَبْيَضَ إِذَا عَصَرْتَهُ بِحُرْقَةٍ لَمْ يَبْقَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مِثْلُ
الْكُحْلِ (النَّشَادِرُ) نَوْعَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا مَعْدَنِيٌّ قِطَاعُ طَرْزَدِ مِلْحٍ حُرٍّ يُعْمَلُ مِنْ سَمَرْقَنْدَ
وَمِنْهُ أَصْفَرُ لَا بُدَّ خَلَلٌ فِي الصَّنْعَةِ وَهُوَ نَشَادِرُ الْعَذَرَةِ فَإِذَا دَرَّتْهُ وَذَوَّبْتَهُ تَذُوبُ بِهَا الْأَحْبَابُ الزَّرْنِيخُ ٦
أَحْمَرُ مَعْدُومٌ وَأَصْفَرُ مُصْمَتٌ كَالْسَنْدَرُوسِ جَرَى صَلْبٌ وَآخَرُ صَافِي عَجِيبٌ مُتَّسِعُ الصُّفْرَةِ وَأَبْيَضُ
عَاجِيٌّ وَأَبْيَضُ مَخْلُوطٌ بِأَتْرَابٍ لَا يَصْلُحُ وَأَسْوَدُ مُخْتَلِطٌ بِأَحْصَى (الْمَرْقَشِيثَا) ٤ أَبْيَضُ فَضِّيٌّ وَأَحْمَرُ
نُحَاسِيٌّ وَأَسْوَدُ حَدِيدِيٌّ وَأَصْفَرُ ذَهَبِيُّ (الْمَغْنِيسَا) أَلْوَانُ تُرَابِيَّةٌ سَوْدَاءُ وَمِنْهَا لَهَا عُيُونٌ لَهَا بَصِيصٌ
وَمِنْهَا قِطَعٌ صَلْبَةٌ حَدِيدِيَّةٌ وَهُوَ ذَكَرٌ وَمِنْهَا أَجْرَدُ هَشِيٌّ أُنْثَى فِيهَا عُيُونٌ تَبْرِقُ وَهُوَ أَجْوَدُ (الرَّوْضُ)
نَوْعَانِ اصْطَخْرِيُّ وَمَاءُ الْحَدِيدِ (التُّوتِيَا) أَلْوَانٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنْهَا أَخْضَرُ قِطَاعٌ وَأَصْفَرُ خَزَفِيٌّ وَمَحْمُودِيٌّ
وَأَخْضَرُ كِرْمَانِيٌّ وَقُشُورِيٌّ وَأَبْيَضُ قِشْرٍ وَزَرْقَا وَهِنْدِيُّ (الرَّهَنْجُ) هُوَ حَجَرٌ أَخْضَرُ وَفِيهِ عُرُوقٌ
تُخَطُّ فِيهِ الْفُصُوصُ وَالْخَرَزُ وَمِنْهُ جَدِيدٌ وَعَتِيقٌ وَمِصْرِيٌّ وَكِرْمَانِيٌّ وَخُرَاسَانِيُّ وَالْكِرْمَانِيُّ
الْعَتِيقُ أَجْوَدُ وَاللَّازَوَرْدُ نَوْعٌ وَاحِدٌ وَهُوَ حَجَرٌ تَجِدُ فِيهِ حُمْرَةً وَعُيُونًا بَرَّاقَةً * وَالْفِيرُوزَجُ نَوْعٌ
وَاحِدٌ وَهُوَ حَجَرٌ فِيهِ حُمْرَةٌ وَعُيُونٌ رَاقَةٌ أَخْضَرُ ذَهَبِيًّا (الشَّاذَنْجُ) أَحْجَارٌ ذَهَبِيَّةٌ وَحُمْرُ الذَّهَبِ
وَتَلُونُهُ لِأَنَّهَا مِنْ جَوَاهِرِ النُّحَاسِ (الشَّكُّ) نَوْعَانِ أَبْيَضُ وَأَصْفَرُ يُؤْتَى بِهِمَا مِنْ مَعَادِنِ الْفِضَّةِ أَبْيَضُ
(وَالْكُحْلُ) نَوْعَانِ مُصْمَتٌ زُجَاجِيٌّ وَمُحِبُّ أَصْفَهَانِيُّ (الطَّلْقُ) أَنْوَاعٌ يَمَانِيٌّ وَبَحْرِيٌّ وَجَبَلِيٌّ
وَيَتَصَفَّحُ إِذَا انْدَقَّ وَلَهُ بَصِيصٌ وَأَجْوَدُهُ الْيَمَانِيُّ ثُمَّ الْبَحْرِيُّ الْأَبْيَضُ الْمُخْتَلِطُ بِالْمَعْدِنِ الْأَحْمَرِ (الرُّجَاجُ
أَنْوَاعٌ) تَتَّخَذُ مِنَ الرَّمْلِ وَأَقَلُّهُ أَجْوَدُهُ الشَّامِيُّ الْأَبْيَضُ الَّذِي يُحَاكِي الْبَلُّورَ فِي صَفَاءِ الزُّجَاجَاتِ
مِنْهَا أَصْفَرُ صَلْبٌ وَمِنْهَا أَصْفَرُ فِيهِ عُيُونٌ ذَهَبِيَّةٌ تَسْتَعْمِلُهُ الْأَسَاكِفَةُ وَالصَّاغُونَ وَمِنْهُ أَصْفَرُ قِطَعٌ
يُشْبِهُ قِطَعَ النِّيلَةِ الْعَجَمِيِّ فِي الصُّفْرِ لَافِي اللَّوْنِ وَهُوَ أَجْوَدُ (الشَّبُّ) أَنْوَاعٌ مِنْهَا أَبْيَضُ يَمَانِيٌّ خُطُوطٌ
وَالطَّرْزَدِيُّ وَمِنْهَا الشَّامِيُّ الْأَبْيَضُ الْمُخْتَلِطُ بِالْطَّيْنِ وَلَحَجَرِ الَّتِي تَشُوبُهُ حُمْرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا الْمِصْرِيُّ الدَّسِمُ
الْأَصْفَرُ وَهُوَ اللَّيِّنُ وَالْكِرْمَانِيُّ اللَّيِّنُ وَهُوَ أَدْسَمُهُمْ لِلْيَضِ الثَّابِتِ (الْقَلْقَنْدُ) زَاجٌ أَبْيَضُ
وَالْقَلْقَدُسُ زَاجٌ أَخْضَرُ (الْقَلْقَطَارُ) زَاجٌ أَصْفَرُ (السُّورِيُّ) زَاجٌ أَحْمَرُ وَهَذِهِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ عَزِيزَةٌ
الْوُجُودِ وَأَعَزُّهَا السُّورِيُّ وَهُوَ يَدْخُلُ فِي بَابِ الْحُمْرَةِ وَتَحْمِلُ مِنْ مَعَادِنِ قَبْرَصَ وَأَصْلُهَا زَاجَاتٌ
وَشُوبٌ وَيَغْسِلُهَا السَّيْلُ وَيُنَزِّهُهَا الْحَفْرُ فَتَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهَا الشَّمْسُ تَعْقِدُهَا وَقَدْ تَتَّخِذُ الْحُكَمَاءُ إِذَا
أَعُوزَهُمْ
text.en:
— 388 —

And you sprinkle upon Venus while it circles a little, and you lead it — there descends the ounce, 4 dirhams.
( Chapter ) On the mention of the drugs, and they are 3 kinds: earthy, vegetative, and animal. So the earthy [is] 6 kinds: spirits, bodies, stones, vitriols, salts, and boraxes. So the spirits [are] 4: quicksilver, natron, sulphur, and orpiment. And the bodies [are] 7: gold, silver, copper, iron, lead, tin, and the specific [ones] of the stones 16: marqashīthā, magnesia, al-rawḍ, lazward, rahanj, dīzawarj, shādhank, shakk, kohl, ṭalaq, ḥibs, al-zāj, al-zājāt, al-qalqand, al-qalqaṭār, al-sūrī. And the boraxes [are] 6: the borax of ḥibr, the borax of the goldsmiths, al-tisqār, the red borax, the borax of rawand, and the western borax — 4 for the salts [are] 11: the good salt, al-murr, ṭarzad, al-andarānī, al-nifṭī, al-hindī, al-'aynī, and the salt of ashes — in them are natural [and] artificial [kinds], known; their colors, and the best of them the spirits of quicksilver that is fine and white — when you press it with burning, nothing remains in it like kohl. ( Natron ) Two kinds: one is mineral, a cutting of ṭarzad of free salt, made from Samarkand; and of it is a yellow — necessarily a defect in the work — and it is the natron of 'udhrah. So when you circulate it and melt it, the beloveds melt by it. Orpiment [is] 6: red, nonexistent; yellow, solid like sandarūs, ran solid; and another pure, wondrous, wide of yellowness; and white, ivory; and white mixed with dust, not suitable; and black mixed with gravel. ( Marqashīthā ) 4: white silvery, red coppery, black iron-y, yellow golden. ( Magnesia ) Earthy black colors; and of it are ones with eyes that have a glint; and of it are hard iron-y pieces — and it is the male; and of it is bare brittle — the female, in which are eyes that sparkle, and it is the best. ( Al-rawḍ ) Two kinds: Isṭakhrī and iron-water. ( Tutiyā ) Many colors: of it green cutting, yellow ceramic, maḥmūdī, green Kirmānī, qushūrī, white of rind, zurqā, and Indian. ( Rahanj ) It is a green stone, and in it are veins in which seals and beads are engraved; and of it is new and old and Egyptian and Kirmānī and Khurasānī, and the old Kirmānī is best. And lazward is one kind, and it is a stone in which you find redness and glittering eyes *; and fīrūzaj is one kind, and it is a stone in which is redness and delicate eyes, green golden. ( Shādhank ) Golden stones and gold-red, and it colors — for it is of the jewels of copper. ( Shakk ) Two kinds: white and yellow, brought from the silver mines — white. ( And kohl ) Two kinds: solid glassy, and the lover of Iṣfahānī. ( Ṭalaq ) Kinds: Yemeni, sea, and mountain; and it flakes when crushed and has a glint; and its best is the Yemeni, then the sea-white mixed with the red mineral. ( Glass, kinds ) Taken from sand, and the least is its best — the white Syrian that rivals crystal in the clarity of glasses; of it is yellow solid, and of it yellow with golden eyes that the cobblers and goldsmiths use; and of it yellow pieces resembling pieces of Ajamī indigo in the yellowness not in the color, and it is the best. ( Alum ) Kinds: of it white Yemeni with lines, and the ṭarzadī; and of it the white Syrian mixed with clay, and a stone that is tinged with redness; and of it the Egyptian dense yellow, and it is soft; and the Kirmānī soft, and it is the softest of them for the fixed precipitate. ( Al-qalqand ) A white vitriol; and al-qalqadūs is a green vitriol. ( Al-qalqaṭār ) A yellow vitriol. ( Al-sūrī ) A red vitriol; and these four are rare of existence, and the rarest of them is the Syrian, and it enters the chapter of redness, and it is borne from the mines of qabaraṣ, and their origin is vitriols and admixture, and the flood washes them and the digging cleanses them, so the sun descends upon them and coagulates them. And the sages may make [a substitute] when it fails them —
text.id:
— 388 —

Dan engkau siram pada Zuhrah saat berputar sedikit, dan engkau pimpin — turun satu auns, 4 dirham.
( Bab ) Tentang sebutan ubat-ubatan, 3 jenis: tanah, tumbuhan, haiwan. Tanah [ada] 6: roh, tubuh, batu, vitriol, garam, boraks. Roh 4: raksa, natron, belerang, orpimen. Tubuh 7: emas, perak, tembaga, besi, plumbum, timah, dan batu khusus 16: marqashitha, magnesia, rawd, lazward, rahanj, dizawarj, shadhank, shakk, kohl, talaq, hibs, zaj, zajat, qalqand, qalqatar, suri. Boraks 6: boraks hibr, boraks tukang emas, tiskar, boraks merah, boraks rawand, boraks barat — garam 11: garam baik, murr, tarzad, andarani, nifti, hindi, 'ayni, garam abu — ada semula jadi dan buatan, dikenali; warnanya, terbaik roh raksa halus putih — bila dipicit dengan bakar tiada tinggal seperti kohl. ( Natron ) Dua: satu mineral, potongan tarzad garam bebas dari Samarkand; ada kuning — pasti cacat kerja — natron 'udhrah; bila edar dan lebur, kekasih lebur olehnya. Orpimen 6: merah tiada, kuning pejal macam sandarus, lagi suatu tulen hairan luas kuning; putih gading; putih bercampur debu tak elok; hitam bercampur kerikil. ( Marqashitha ) 4: putih perak, merah tembaga, hitam besi, kuning emas. ( Magnesia ) Hitam tanah; ada bermata berkilat; ada keras besi — jantan; ada telanjang rapuh — betina, mata berkelip, terbaik. ( Rawd ) Dua: Istakhri, air besi. ( Tutiya ) Banyak warna: hijau potong, kuning seramik, mahmudi, hijau Kirmans, qushuri, putih kulit, zurqa, India. ( Rahanj ) Batu hijau bercanal ukir mohor dan manik; ada baharu, lama, Mesir, Kirmans, Khurasan, lama Kirmans terbaik. Lazward satu, batu berjalur merah dan mata berkilau *; firuzaj satu, batu merah bermata halus hijau emas. ( Shadhank ) Batu emas dan merah-emas, berwarna — dari permata tembaga. ( Shakk ) Dua: putih dan kuning dari lombong perak — putih. ( Kohl ) Dua: pejal kaca, kekasih Ispahani. ( Talaq ) Yemen, laut, gunung; berkeping bila ditumbuk, berkilat; terbaik Yemeni, lalu laut-putih bercampur mineral merah. ( Kaca ) Dari pasir, sedikit terbaik — putih Syria menanding hablur; ada kuning pejal, kuning bermata emas dipakai tukang kasut dan emas; ada kuning macam indigo Ajami pada kuning bukan warna, terbaik. ( Alum ) Putih Yemen berjalur, tarzadi; Syria putih bercampur tanah dan batu kemerahan; Mesir pekat kuning lembut; Kirmans lembut, paling lembut untuk mendakan tetap. ( Qalqand ) Vitriol putih; qalqadus vitriol hijau. ( Qalqatar ) Vitriol kuning. ( Suri ) Vitriol merah; keempat jarang, Suri paling jarang, masuk bab merah, dari lombong qabarash, asal vitriol dan campuran, banjir basuh, gali bersihkan, matahari koagulasikan. Cerdik buat ganti bila tiada —

title.ar: فصل في العقاقير: الترابية والنباتية والحيوانية
title.en: Chapter on Drugs: Earthy, Plant and Animal Types
title.id: Bab tentang Ubat-ubatan: Jenis Tanah, Tumbuhan dan Haiwan

text.ar:
- ۳۸۹ -

أعوزهم ذلك ويقوم مقامها ويكون أجل منها فعلاً في اتخاذ القلقندس. قال: وأجل منه تأخذ الشب
الأبيض فتجله وتصفيه ثم تقطر الزاج وتحله وتصفيه وتطرح فيه برادة النحاس حتى يحضر
وتصفيه في الحامة وتضعه في قدر نحاس وتطبخه بعد أن تجعل في العشرة نصف درهم نشادر
وتتركه حتى ينعقد. وأجل منه أن تطبخ الزاج الأصفر بالماء وتصفيه وتجعل فيه مثل الزاج زجاجاً
وتتركه أياماً حتى ينحل فيه وتحضره ثم تصفيه ثم تعقده. وأجل منه أن تأخذ زاجاً وتحله وتصفيه
وتضع مثله زعفراناً جيداً هيه وتطبخه جيداً فيخرج أحمر، ويقوم مقام هذا الشوشا بعض الأوقات
فاعزله. (اتخاذ القلقطار) تأخذ الزاج تحله بماء وتصفيه وتجعل فيه مثل ربعه الماء الصفرة المقطورة
وتجمده. اتخاذ السوى تأخذ الزاج وماء الزاج المصفى وتشويه حتى يحمر، فهذه الزجاجة التي
اتخذوها للحمرة وهي أجل من المعدنية. (والبوارق) منها بورق حري وبورق الصناعة وهو
أبيض يشبه السبخة التي تكون في أصل الحيطان، ومنها بورق الراوندي لونه يتلألأ بحمرة وهو
أجود البوارق. (التسكار) هو بورق يتخذ داودم. (صفة عمل التسكار) تأخذ من ملح القلى
الأبيض جزءاً ومن البوارق الأبيض المصفى ثلاثة أجزاء وصب عليها من لبن الجاموس ما يغمرها
واطبخها حتى تنعقد وبندقها وجففها في الشمس واستعملها في حاجتك. (وأجل منه) أن تأخذ من
ملح القلى الأبيض ومن النطرون والبورق المصفى والملح الأندواني وملح البول والنشادر من كل
واحد جزءاً مسحوقاً مثل الهباء واسحقهم بلبن البقر بقدر ما يجمع أجزاءهم واتركهم حتى يجفوا
تفعله ثلاث مرات ثم بندقه وعلقه في الشمس أربعين يوماً حتى يرسخ ويصفو داخله. (ملح النورة)
خذ من الجير غير المطفى ودبره تدبير ملح القلى ينحل ماء أبيض. (ملح بول) خذ منه عشرة أرطال
وضعه في قرابة واتركه في الشمس أربعين يوماً في أشد حر أيام السنة فإذا انقد وصار ملحاً وإلا
طينها بطين الحكمة وضعها على رماد حار وكلما برد الرماد جدد له رماد آخر غيره حتى ينعقد
طبرزداً أيضاً إن عملت فيه كما عملت في ملح القلى كان أولى، وهو أن تجعله في كزان رقة وتجعله
على الحامات وكلما ثبت عليها تمسحه أولاً بأول كلما قطر من الحامات تحل ملحاً. (وأجل منه)
أن تأخذ ماشئت تنقعه شهراً ثم تقطر وتضع في كل رطل مما قطرته ٤ أواق ملح قلى وتعقده في
عميا فإنه ينعقد في ٣ أيام كالبلور. (وأجل منه) أن تأخذ ماشئت تنقعه شهرين ثم تقطره وتضع
في كل رطل وتكلسه حتى البياض ثم تجعل ما قطرته. (العقاقير الثابتة) قال خواص الحكماء:
أجل ما استعمل منها الأشنان المسيحي الطيب الرائحة ومنه عملت الحكماء إكسيراً وإليها أشاروا
وعليها رمزوا وعليها أكثروا وهي أحجار عشرة: الشعر والتحف والدماغ والمرارة والدم واللبن
والبول والصدف والبيض والقرن، وأجلها الشعر ثم الدماغ ثم الصدف ثم الدم. (صفة
عقد عيد) خذ ماشئت منه واسحقه بالخردل ٣ ساعات حتى يسود واطبخه بالخل والملح حتى
يصفر فاجعله في حفرة على الأرض وامسح على وجهه بزيت حتى يمنع عنه التراب ثم انثر عليه نثراً
خفيفاً من الأبيض المتحول ثم صب فوقه من الأسرب والقل المذابين قدر ما يغطيه بلفظ إصبع
تفعل ذلك مراراً حتى ينعقد حجراً. (صفة تكليس المريخ) تأخذ من برادة المريخ ماشئت
text.en:
- 389 -

it fails them, and it stands in its place and is better than it in the making of al-qalqandūs. He said: and better than it — you take white alum and gild it and filter it; then you distill the vitriol and dissolve it and filter it, and throw into it copper-filings until it appears, and filter it in the ḥāma, and place it in a copper pot and cook it after you put in the ten half a dirham of natron, and leave it until it coagulates. And better than it: that you cook the yellow vitriol with water and filter it, and put in it like the vitriol glass, and leave it days until it dissolves in it and appears, then filter it then coagulate it. And better than it: that you take a vitriol and dissolve it and filter it and put in it the like of good saffron — thus — and cook it well, and it comes out red; and this shūshā stands in the place of that at some times, so isolate it. ( The making of al-qalqaṭār ) You take vitriol, dissolve it in water and filter it, and put in it the like of a quarter of it of the distilled yellow water, and solidify it. The making of al-sawā: you take vitriol and the filtered vitriol-water and roast it until it reddens — so this is the glass they made for redness, and it is better than the mineral. ( And the boraxes ) Of them is the borax of ḥārī, and the borax of the craft which is white and resembles the efflorescence that is at the base of walls; and of them is the borax of rawand, its color glitters with redness, and it is the best of the boraxes. ( Al-tisqār ) It is a borax made at Dāwūdm. ( The working of al-tisqār ) You take of the white qalī-salt a part, and of the filtered white borax three parts, and pour upon them of buffalo-milk what submerges them, and cook them until they coagulate, and pellet them and dry them in the sun, and use them in your need. ( And better than it ) that you take of white qalī-salt and natron and filtered borax and andarānī salt and urine-salt and natron, of each one part powdered like dust, and grind them with cow-milk according to what gathers their parts, and leave them until they dry — do it three times; then pellet it and suspend it in the sun forty days until it firms and clears inside. ( Lime-salt ) Take of un-slaked lime and govern it with the government of qalī-salt — it dissolves white water. ( Urine-salt ) Take of it ten ratls and place it in a jar and leave it in the sun forty days in the most intense heat of the year; so if it congeals and becomes salt, [good]; else clay it with the clay of wisdom and place it on hot ashes, and whenever the ashes cool renew for it other ashes than it until it coagulates. Ṭabarzad also — if you work in it as you worked in qalī-salt it is preferable; and it is that you put it in thin glasses and put it on the ḥāmas, and whenever it settles on them you wipe it first by first — whenever it drops from the ḥāmas it dissolves salt. ( And better than it ) that you take what you will and soak it a month, then distill, and put in each ratl of what you distilled 4 ounces of qalī-salt, and coagulate it in 'umayya — so it coagulates in 3 days like crystal. ( And better than it ) that you take what you will and soak it two months, then distill it, and put in each ratl and calcine it to whiteness, then put what you distilled. ( The fixed drugs ) The specific of the sages said: the best of what they used of them is the Christian soapwort of good smell, and from it the sages made an elixir, and to it they pointed and upon it they symbolized and upon it they multiplied; and they are ten stones: hair, skull, brain, gall, blood, milk, urine, shell, egg, and horn — and the best of them is hair, then brain, then shell, then blood. ( The making of the 'īd-knot ) Take what you will of it and grind it with mustard 3 hours until it blackens, and cook it with vinegar and salt until it yellows; then place it in a pit in the earth and wipe upon its face with oil so it is prevented from the earth; then scatter upon it a light scattering of the transformed white, then pour upon it of the melted lead and qāl — what covers it by the measure of a finger — do that repeatedly until it coagulates into a stone. ( The description of calcining Mars ) You take of iron-filings what you will —
text.id:
- ۳۸۹ -

bila tiada, ia ganti dan lebih baik membuat al-qalqandus. Katanya: lebih baik — ambil alum putih, gilding tapis; suling vitriol larut tapis, masuk habuk tembaga hingga nampak, tapis di hama, taruh periuk tembaga masak dengan separuh dirham natron per sepuluh, biar membeku. Lebih baik: masak vitriol kuning air tapis, masuk macam vitriol kaca, biar hari larut nampak, tapis koagulasikan. Lebih baik: ambil vitriol larut tapis, masuk macam za'faran baik — masak, keluar merah; shusha ganti itu kadang, maka asingkan. ( Buat qalqatar ) Vitriol larut air tapis, masuk suku air kuning suling, pejal. Buat sawa: vitriol dan air vitriol tapis, bakar hingga merah — kaca dibuat untuk merah, lebih baik dari mineral. ( Boraks ) Boraks hari, boraks kerajinan putih macam mekar di kaki dinding; boraks rawand kilau merah, terbaik. ( Tisqar ) Boraks dibuat di Dawudm. ( Kerja tisqar ) Garam qali putih satu, boraks putih tapis tiga, tuang susu kerbau rendam, masak beku, bentuk pil kering matahari, pakai perlu. ( Lebih baik ) Garam qali putih, natron, boraks tapis, garam andarani, garam kencing, natron — tiap satu bahagian tumbuk halus, giling susu lembu, biar kering 3 kali; bentuk pil gantung matahari 40 hari hingga keras jernih. ( Garam kapur ) Ambil kapur tak padam, tata macam garam qali — larut air putih. ( Garam kencing ) Sepuluh ratl taruh balang matahari 40 hari paling panas; bila beku jadi garam [baik]; bila tidak, tanam tanah hikmah di atas abu panas, abu sejuk ganti hingga membeku. Tabarzad juga — bila kerja macam garam qali lebih baik; taruh kaca nipis di hama, bila mendak sapu, bila titis larut garam. ( Lebih baik ) Rendam sebulan suling, tiap ratl 4 auns garam qali, beku di umayya 3 hari macam hablur. ( Lebih baik ) Rendam dua bulan suling, tiap ratl kalsin putih, masuk yang disuling. ( Ubat tetap ) Cerdik: terbaik sabunut Kristian harum, darinya eliksir, ditunjuk dan disimbolkan; sepuluh batu: rambut, tengkorak, otak, empedu, darah, susu, kencing, ciput, telur, tanduk — terbaik rambut, lalu otak, ciput, darah. ( Simpul 'id ) Ambil giling dengan bijik sawi 3 jam hingga hitam, masak cuka garam hingga kuning; taruh lubang tanah sapu minyak cegah tanah; tabur putih bertukar halus, tuang plumbum dan qal cair tutup sejari berulang hingga jadi batu. ( Kalsin Marikh ) Ambil habuk besi apa jua —

title.en: Making Qalqandus with Alum, Vitriol and Copper
title.id: Pembuatan Qalqandus dengan Tawas, Vitriol dan Tembaga

text.ar:
— ٣٩٠ —

ثُمَّ تَنْقَعُهَا فِي مَاءِ الْعُقَابِ أُسْبُوعًا وَاغْسِلْهَا بِيَدِكَ عَرْكًا جَيِّدًا ثُمَّ ضَعْهَا فِي مِقْعَرَةِ حَدِيدٍ وَضَعْهَا عَلَى النَّارِ
نِصْفَ نَهَارٍ ثُمَّ أَلْقِهَا فِيهَا وَهِيَ بِحَرَارَتِهَا ثُمَّ أَسْقِطْهَا فِي مَاءِ الْمَطَرِ وَاسْحَقْهَا، وَكُلَّمَا نَشِفَ الْمَاءُ زِدْهُ
مَاءً آخَرَ حَتَّى يَبْقَى مِثْلَ الْأَسْفِيدَاجِ ثُمَّ خُذْ مِنَ الْمِلْحِ بَعْدَ بَيَاضِهِ أُوقِيَّةً وَتَعْجِنُ بِالزَّيْتِ الطَّيِّبِ وَيُصَفَّى
فِي خِرْقَةٍ خَفِيفَةٍ وَطَيِّنْهَا وَاحْفِصْهَا وَاجْعَلْهَا فِي آنِيَةٍ صَابِرَةٍ عَلَى النَّارِ وَيَتَّهَا فِي نَارِ فُرْنِ فَخَّارٍ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ
كَرِّرْ عَلَيْهَا هَذَا التَّدْبِيرَ ٣ حَتَّى تَرَاهُ كَالْأَسْرَبِ اطْرَحْ وَزْنَ دِرْهَمٍ عَلَى ٨ قَلْعِيٍّ مُصَفًّى وَأَضِفْ لَهُ
دِرْهَمَيْنِ قِرًا وَاسْكُبْهُمْ يَقُومُوا ( الْقَوْلُ فِي الْقَلْعِيِّ وَتَكْلِيسِهِ ) تَأْخُذُ مِنْهُ مَا شِئْتَ وَتَجْعَلُهُ صَفَائِحَ
رِقَاقًا وَخُذْ مِثْلَ وَزْنِهِ مِلْحًا مَسْحُوقًا وَاجْعَلْ وِقَاءً مِنَ الْمِلْحِ حَتَّى يَمْلَأَ الْكُوزَ وَشُدَّ
وِصَالَهُ وَطَيِّنْهُ بِطِينِ الْحِكْمَةِ وَاتْرُكْهُ حَتَّى يَجِفَّ وَيَتَّهُ فِي السَّاكُونِ لَيْلَةً وَأَخْرِجْهُ وَبَرِّدْهُ وَاسْحَقْهُ
وَاعْغِسِلْهُ بِمَاءٍ عَذْبٍ وَاتْرُكْهُ حَتَّى رَسَبَ رَقَّ عَنْهُ الْمَاءُ وَالْمِلْحُ وَأَلْقِ عَلَيْهِ مَاءً آخَرَ وَكَرِّرِ الْعَمَلَ حَتَّى
يَصِيرَ مِثْلَ أَسْفِيدَاجٍ اسْحَقْهُ بِزَيْتٍ وَنَطْرُونٍ وَصُرَّهُ فِي خِرْقَةٍ رَقِيقَةٍ خَفِيفَةٍ، طَيِّنْهَا وَجَفِّفْهَا وَضَعْهَا فِي
قِدْرِ حَدِيدٍ وَشُدَّ فَمَ الْقِدْرِ وَغَطِّ، وَطَيِّنْهُ وَاتْرُكْهُ فِي فُرْنِ الْجِيرِ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً ثُمَّ أَخْرِجْهُ وَاسْحَقْهُ وَشَمِّعْهُ
بِالزَّيْتِ وَالنَّطْرُونِ وَضَعْهَا فِي الْقِدْرِ وَكَرِّرِ الْعَمَلَ ٣ ثُمَّ اسْتَنْزِلْهَا مِنْ بُوطٍ إِلَى آخَرَ بِالزَّيْتِ الطَّيِّبِ
وَالنَّطْرُونِ فَإِنَّهَا تَصِيرُ مِثْلَ النَّشَادُرِ وَأَشَدَّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ الْفِضَّةِ وَذَهَبَ إِحْرَاقُهَا وَنَتَنُهَا وَصَرِيرُهَا
تُحَاكِي الْفِضَّةَ وَلَا تَكْسِرْهَا فَاسْحَقْهَا وَأَلْقِ مِنْهَا دِرْهَمًا وَدِرْهَمًا فِضَّةً عَلَى ١٠ زَهْرَةٍ تَعْمَلُهَا دَرَاهِمَ
مِيرِيَّةً تَجِيءُ غَايَةً وَتَحْضُرُهَا بِالْحَضْرَةِ الْمُتَقَدِّ. ذِكْرُهَا ( صِفَةُ تَكْلِيسِ الْأَسْرَبِ ) تُذِيبُهُ فِي مِقْعَرَةِ
حَدِيدٍ وَقَصِّرِ النُّورَةَ عَلَيْهِ قَلِيلًا فَإِنَّهُ يَصِيرُ رَمَادًا أَبْيَضَ وَهُوَ أَحْسَنُ التَّكَالِيسِ وَاسْحَقْهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ
الْعَذْبِ إِلَى أَنْ يَلْتَئِمَ فَشَمِّعْهُ مَاعِزٍ وَمِثْلَهُ عَظْمًا مُحْرَقًا مِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَضَعْهُ فِي كُوزٍ وَطَيِّنْهُ وَدَعْهُ إِلَى أَنْ
يَجِفَّ وَضَعْهُ فِي تَنُّورِ فَخَّارٍ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ خُذْهُ وَاسْحَقْهُ تَرَاهُ أَبْيَضَ فَوْقَ الْعَظْمِ الْمُحْرَقِ مِثْلَ الْحِيضِ
الْأَبْيَضِ وَهُوَ الزَّادُ أَلْقِ مِنْهُ وَزْنَ دِرْهَمٍ عَلَى ٣٠ مِنَ الزَّهْرَةِ يُقِيمُهَا قَمَرًا رَوَّابًا صَافِيًا أَلْقِ مِنْهُ نِصْفَ دِرْهَمٍ
عَلَى ١٠ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ يُقِيمُهُ قَمَرًا لَا يَتَغَيَّرُ ( صِفَةُ عَقْدٍ ) يُؤْخَذُ ١٠ دِرْهَمٍ عُقَابٍ يَسْحَقُهَا مَعَ دِرْهَمَيْنِ
قِشْرِ بَيْضٍ ثُمَّ دَوِّرْهُمْ فِي مِقْعَرَةٍ يُدَوِّرُهَا وَأَثْرِلْهُمْ وَاسْحَقْ مَعَهُمْ دِرْهَمَ قِشْرِ بَيْضٍ وَعُدْهُمْ إِلَى الْمِقْعَرَةِ
يَدُورُوا تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ٣ يَبْقَ سَرِيعَ الدَّوَرَانِ ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ ١٠ دَرَاهِمَ عَبْدٍ وَدِرْهَمَيْنِ مِنْ هَذَا الدَّوَاءِ
وَتَجْعَلُ فَوْقَهُ وَتَحْتَهُ بَعْدَ السَّحْقِ وَيَتَّهُ تَحْتَ اللَّمْسِ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَلْقِ مِنْهُ دِرْهَمًا عَلَى ٩
قَلْعِيٍّ يَقُومُ بِهَا ( صِفَةُ تَرْكِيبِهِ مُحَرَّبَةً ) يُؤْخَذُ حَجَرُ جِيرٍ وَرَهْنَتَجٌ ثَابِتٌ وَشَبٌّ يَمَانٍ وَمِلْحُ قَلِي وَنَطْرُونٌ
وَجُزْءُ نَشَادُرٍ ثَابِتٌ وَجُزْءُ تِنْكَارٍ يُسْحَقُونَ فُرَادَى وَمَجْمُوعِينَ ثُمَّ يُلَتُّونَ بِبَيَاضِ الْبَيْضِ وَيَيْبَسُ ثُمَّ إِذَا
أَرَدْتَ الْعَمَلَ رَوِّقِ الزَّهْرَةَ لِحَمَامِهِ مِثْلَ الدِّرْهَمِ وَطَهِّرْهَا وَتُقَرَّصُ بِالْكَازِ صِغَارًا ثُمَّ يُؤْخَذُ مِنَ الْمَعْمُولِ
لِلْبَيْضِ عَلَى قَدْرِ الزَّهْرَةِ وَتُعْمَلُ فِي وَدَقَةٍ وَتُسْبَكُ وَتُقَلَّبُ فِي زَيْتٍ طَيِّبٍ لَمْ يُصَالِحْ أَبَدًا ثُمَّ أَضِفْ إِلَيْهَا
مَا تَخْتَارُ ( صِفَةُ تَدْبِيرِ الْمَرْقَشِيثَا ) تَأْخُذُ مِنْهَا مَا شِئْتَ وَاسْحَقْهُ جَيِّدًا وَلُتَّهُ بِالصَّابُونِ وَالنَّطْرُونِ
وَاسْبِكْهُ فِي بُوطٍ وَتَأْخُذُ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْمَسْبُوكِ الْخَالِصِ وَتَرْمِي التَّفَلَ وَإِنْ كَرَّرْتَ الْعَمَلَ كَمَا تَقَدَّمَ
يَعْنِي أَوَّلَهُ وَثَانِيَهُ وَثَالِثَهُ كَانَ أَجْوَدَ ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ الْخَالِصَ مِنْهَا نُقْرَةً بَيْضَاءَ رَابِيَةً تُشْبِهُ الْفِضَّةَ إِلَّا أَنَّهَا تُفَتَّتُ
فَتَسْحَقُهَا وَتَلُتُّهَا بِنَشَادُرٍ مَحْلُولٍ بِخَلٍّ وَشَمِّعِ الْمِقْعَرَةَ الْمَذْكُورَةَ حَتَّى تَسْتَوْعِبَهُ فَإِنَّهَا كَسِرِّ يَجِدُ يُفِيدُكَ
عَنْ
text.en:
— 390 —

Then you soak it in the water of the eagle for a week, and wash it with your hand, a good rubbing; then put it in an iron basin and put it on the fire
half a day, then cast it into it while it is at its heat, then drop it into rain water and crush it, and whenever the water dries up, add to it
another water until it remains like asfidāj; then take from the salt after its whiteness, an ounce, and knead with good oil, and it is strained
in a light cloth, and clay it and preserve it, and make it in a vessel patient upon the fire, and heat it in the fire of a pottery oven for a night, then
repeat upon it this procedure 3 until you see it like asrab. Throw the weight of a dirham upon 8 purified qalʿī, and add to it
two dirhams of qirā, and pour them, they rise up. (The saying concerning qalʿī and its calcination.) You take from it what you wish and make it thin plates.
And take like its weight powdered salt, and make a covering from the salt until it fills the jug, and tighten
its joining and clay it with the clay of wisdom, and leave it until it dries, and heat it in the sākūn for a night, and take it out and cool it and crush it.
And wash it with sweet water and leave it until it settles; the water and the salt become thin from it, and pour upon it another water, and repeat the work until
it becomes like asfidāj. Crush it with oil and natron, and tie it in a thin light cloth; clay it and dry it, and put it in
an iron pot, and tighten the mouth of the pot and cover, and clay it and leave it in the lime oven a day and a night, then take it out and crush it and wax it
with oil and natron, and put it in the pot and repeat the work 3 times, then bring it down from one būt to another with good oil
and natron, for it becomes like sal ammoniac and whiter than silver, and the burning of it, and its stench, and its creaking
imitate silver. Do not break it, so crush it, and cast from it a dirham and a dirham of silver upon 10 zahra; you make them dirhams
mīriyyah; it comes exceedingly, and you bring it with the advanced presence. Mention of it: (The description of calcining qalʿī.) You melt it in an iron basin
and shorten the lime upon it a little, for it becomes white ash, and it is the best of the calcinations. Crush it and wash it with sweet water
until it coheres, then wax it with goat, and likewise a burnt bone from cattle, and put it in a jug and clay it and leave it until
it dries, and put it in a pottery oven for one night, then take it and crush it; you will see it white above the burnt bone like white menses,
and it is the provision. Cast from it the weight of a dirham upon 30 of the zahra; it establishes it as a clear, flowing moon. Cast from it half a dirham
upon 10 of the ʿabd; it establishes it as a moon that does not change. (Description of a binding.) 10 dirhams of eagle are taken; you crush it with two dirhams of
eggshell, then rotate them in a basin that he rotates, and sift them, and crush with them a dirham of eggshell, and return them to the basin
to rotate; do that 3 times, it remains quick in rotation. Then you take 10 dirhams of ʿabd and two dirhams of this medicine
and put it above it and beneath it after crushing, and heat it under touch for one night, and cast from it a dirham upon 9
qalʿī; it establishes it. (Description of its composition, tested.) Lime stone, and fixed rahnatāj, and Yemeni alum, and salt of kali, and natron,
and a part of fixed sal ammoniac, and a part of tinkār; they are crushed separately and together, then kneaded with egg white and dried. Then if
you want the work, refine the zahra for its bath like the dirham and purify it, and it is made into small pieces with the kāz. Then take from the made
for the egg according to the amount of the zahra, and it is worked in a small vessel and melted and turned in good oil that has never been reconciled at all, then add to it
what you choose. (Description of the management of the marqashīthā.) You take from it what you wish and crush it well and knead it with soap and natron
and melt it in a būt, and you take what comes out of the pure melted material and throw away the dregs. And if you repeat the work as has preceded,
meaning its first, second, and third, it was better. Then you take the pure from it, a white, swelling nugget resembling silver except that it is fragmented,
so you crush it and knead it with sal ammoniac dissolved in vinegar, and wax the aforementioned basin until it absorbs it, for it is like a secret one finds, it benefits you

— 390 —

lalu rendam air 'uqab seminggu, basuh tangan gosok baik; taruh kuali besi di api separuh hari; campak bila panas, jatuh air hujan giling — bila kering tambah air hingga macam serus. Ambil garam setelah putih satu auns, uli minyak baik, tapis kain halus, tanam jaga, taruh bekas tahan api, bakar dapur tembikar semalam; ulang 3 kali hingga nampak macam plumbum. Tuang seberat dirham pada 8 tutiya suci, tambah 2 dirham qir, tuang — naik. ( Tutiya dan kalsinnya ) Ambil apa jua jadi keping nipis, garam tumbuk seberatnya, isi jug, ikat mulut tanah hikmah, kering bakar sakun semalam; keluarkan sejuk giling basuh air tawar biar mendak halus, air lain ulang hingga macam serus. Giling minyak natron balut kain nipis tanah kering taruh periuk besi tutup tanam dapur kapur sehari semalam; ulang 3 kali; turun dari bót ke bót minyak natron, jadi macam natron lebih putih perak, bakar bau cret hilang — menanding perak, jangan patah, giling tuang dirham dan dirham perak pada 10 Zuhrah jadi dirham Miri puncak, bawa dengan hadirin disebut. ( Kalsin plumbum ) Lebur kuali besi, tabur kapur sedikit jadi abu putih, kalsin terbaik; giling basuh air tawar hingga sembuh, lilin dengan lemak kambing dan tulang lembu bakar, taruh jug tanam kering, tanur tembikar semalam; keluarkan giling nampak lebih putih dari tulang bakar macam haid putih, ia bekal. Tuang dirham pada 30 Zuhrah — jadi bulan mengalir suci; separuh dirham pada 10 hamba — bulan tak berubah. ( Simpul ) 10 dirham 'uqab giling 2 dirham kulit telur; putar kuali siram giling 1 dirham kulit telur, ulang ke kuali 3 kali kekal laju. Ambil 10 dirham hamba 2 dirham ubat ini, atas bawah selepas giling, bakar bawah sentuhan semalam; tuang dirham pada 9 tutiya — naik. ( Susun berani ) Batu kapur, rahantaj tetap, alum Yaman, garam qali, natron, natron tetap, tankar — tumbuk asing sama; uli putih telur kering. Bila kerja, gosok Zuhrah mandi macam dirham, suci, dicubit qaz kecil; ambil buatan telur sama Zuhrah, kerja lesung tuang kacau minyak baik tak pernah campur, tambah apa dipilih. ( Tata marqashitha ) Ambil giling baik uli sabun natron, tuang bót, ambil keluar tuangan suci buang endapan; ulang maka lebih baik. Ambil suci perak putih menyimpan macam perak kecuali hancur, giling uli natron larut cuka, lilin kuali hingga serap — rahsia berguna dari —

text.ar:
— ٣٩١ —

عن غيره ألق منه على القلعي المنقى تصبه ويقطع صريره وندمه ثم ألق من ذلك القلعي على
النحاس الأحمر بيضه بياضاً محكماً فامزجه بالفضة كيف شئت فتنتفع به من يومك فهو أجود
الأعمال (صفة أخرى أجل من الأولى) وذلك أن تأخذ من الحرقوص الحلبي تجعله مثل
الفول ثم تحمى الحجى المعتاد وتطفئه في زيت طيب كذلك ثم عسل نحل ثم صابون
مضروب بماء الليمون الأخضر ثم تأخذ منه ١١ درهماً ثم يضاف لذلك ٣ دراهم عبدو درهم على
أصفر ودرهم قلى حجر يسحق الجميع ويؤتى بزيت طيب ونطرون ثم ينزل من بوط إلى بوط تنزل
فرخة كالنجمة ثم يؤخذ منها ١٠ دراهم من الزهرة الصفراء ١٠ ومن الفضة المفروضة ١٠
وتسبك ذلك فإنه يأتي للحق وذكر لي أحد المغاربة أنه إذا أخذ النطرون الأحمر السلطاني ومثله
الجير الرخامي وزاد بعضهم القلى وتسحقهم جيداً ودسمهم في قدرة في الفرن يومين بليلتين ثم
أخرجهم وعلق في حقة على النار فيها ٣ أمثال الأحجار من الماء العذب وارم فيها من تلك الأحجار
المكلسة شيئاً فشيئاً والماء يغلي غلياناً قوياً إلى أن ينقص الثلث والماء يغلي بعد حلهم يصير ماء حاراً
تقطر منه على العبد بريشة على نار تدريجاً أول مرة نار فتيلة الثانية ضعفها ٣ والثالثة ضعف
ضعفها ٣ والسر كله في النار فإذا أوقفت عبدك وقيدته بهذين القيدين وسقيته من الماء فقد
ملكت الدرجتين الشقراء والحمراء إذ كل خير لا يكون إلا من جنس ذلك الحجرين ومنهم من
أخذ ذلك المنصفى وهو سخن كالنار ويسحق من العقرب ٣ أواق وترميها فوراً في الماء في مقدار
رطل فإنه ينحل ويصير كالبحر الأسود وتلق فيهم ٣ أواق شعر شاب فينحل ولم تزل تعاد ذلك الماء
من ماجور إلى آخر في نار فرن وهكذا إلى أن ينعقد الراب ويصعد على وجهه دهنة صفراء
كالزعفران اقشطها بالملعقة ثم خذ الحرقوص الحلبي الكلوه أحمه وأطفئه في تلك الدهنة ٢١ ثم
تأخذ منه أوقية من أقمر المشبب المرزن مثله ثم اسبكه تخرج القمر وحده مصبوغاً كالذهب
(صفة رجراج) تأخذ ٦٠ حنظلة تقطعها بسكين خشب ثم تأخذ رطلين نطروناً وتسحقهم
وتخلط الجميع وتضعهم في قابلة وتأخذ الماء تحفظ عليه وتأخذ للبرادة رطل عقرب واقسمه ٤
أقسام واقسم البرادة منهم ودسمها ثم أخرجها واسحقها بقسم آخر وهكذا لتمام الأربعة أقسام
تصير البرادة حمراء تأخذ رطل عبد وتغسله بالماء والخردل ثم تقله بياض البيض وتغسله بالماء
السخن ثم نفرش له من البرادة غطاء ووطاء وتغمره من ماء الحنظل في قدح تشميع زجاج مطين
على كانون نافخ روحه وكلما نقص الماء تزيده إلى أن يموت وينقطع حسه تحميه في بوط وتطعم
الشمع والشعر فإنه ثابت لا ينقص وزنه ولا يتغير (صفة مقلة قوية سهلة) وذلك أن تأخذ من
الحجر المكرم الذي هو المادة وأثاب الإلهي والليل اليم والسراج المنير وشمس الآفاق وقهرها
المفهوم الذي هو أول الأشياء وألطفها وهو شعر الآدمي وخاصته حلمته ما شئت اقرضه بعد غسله
بالصابون والطفل وجففه جيداً حتى ينزل من المنخل خذ منه رطلاً ومن ماء الرأس المحلول فيه
الزجاج (وصفة الزاج) أن تأخذ الزاج الأصفر الجيد تسحقه جيداً وتضعه في كوز أو قزاز
مطين مأخوذ الوصل ورشه نخل حاذق ودسمه في نار فرن حارة وأخرجه واسحقه وذبه بالحل
text.en:
— 391 —

from another; cast from it upon the purified qalʿī, it will strike it and cut off its creaking and its regret; then cast from that qalʿī upon
red copper, whiten it with a firm whiteness, then mix it with silver however you wish, and you will benefit from it from your day; for it is the best
of works. (Another description, more noble than the first.) That is that you take from the Aleppine ḥarqūs, make it like
beans, then heat the customary pebbles and quench them in good oil likewise, then honey of bees, then soap
beaten with the water of green lemon, then take from it 11 dirhams, then to that are added 3 dirhams ʿabdu, one dirham of
yellow, and one dirham of stone alkali; crush all together, and good oil and natron are brought, then it is brought down from būt to būt; a
chick descends like the star, then from it are taken 10 dirhams of yellow zahra, 10, and of the imposed silver, 10,
and that is melted, for it comes to the truth. And one of the Maghrebis told me that if one takes the royal red natron and likewise
marble lime, and some add alkali, and crushes them well and fats them in a pot in the oven for two days with two nights, then
take them out and hang in a small case over the fire, in which are 3 times the stones of sweet water, and cast into it from those stones
calcined little by little, while the water boils a strong boiling until a third diminishes, and the water, after their dissolution, becomes hot water;
drip from it upon the ʿabd with a feather over a fire gradually: the first time a wick-fire, the second its double 3, and the third the double
of its double 3, and the whole secret is in the fire. So if you stop your ʿabd and bind it with these two bonds and give it to drink from the water, then you have
possessed the two degrees, the yellow and the red, since every good is only from the kind of those two stones. And among them is one who
took that al-munṣafī, and it is hot as fire, and 3 uqiyyas of scorpion are crushed and thrown immediately into the water in the amount of
a ratl, for it dissolves and becomes like the black sea, and 3 uqiyyas of gray hair are cast into it, and it dissolves. And that water was not ceased to be returned
from one jar to another in the fire of an oven, and thus until the rāb congeals and a yellow grease rises upon its face
like saffron; scrape it off with the spoon. Then take the Aleppine ḥarqūs, the whole of it, heat it and quench it in that grease 21, then
take from it an uqiyyah of the moon, the shabbīb, the marzan, likewise, then melt it; the moon comes out alone, dyed like gold.
(Description of rajrāj.) You take 60 ḥanẓalah, cut them with a wooden knife, then take two ratls of natron and crush them
and mix all together and put them in a qabalah, and take the water, preserve it upon it, and take for the filings a ratl of scorpion and divide it 4
parts, and divide the filings among them and fatten it, then take it out and crush it with another part, and thus until the completion of the four parts;
the filings become red. You take a ratl of ʿabd and wash it with water and mustard, then fry it with egg white and wash it with hot
water, then spread for it from the filings a covering and a bedding, and drown it with the water of the colocynth in a glass cup waxed and clayed
upon a furnace blowing its spirit, and whenever the water diminishes you increase it until it dies and its sense is cut off; you heat it in a būt and feed
the wax and the hair, for it is fixed, its weight does not diminish and does not change. (Description of a strong, easy maqla.) That is that you take from
the honored stone, which is the matter, and the divine reward, and the night, the deep sea, and the luminous lamp, and the sun of the horizons, and its subduing
the understood, which is the first of things and the subtlest of them, and it is human hair and its special part, its nipple; cut it as you wish after washing it
with soap and clay, and dry it well until it descends from the sieve. Take from it a ratl and from the water of the head in which is dissolved
glass. (Description of zāj.) That you take good yellow zāj, crush it well, and put it in a jug or a glass
clayed, with the joint taken, and sprinkle it with a skillful sieve, and fatten it in a hot oven fire, and take it out and crush it and dissolve it with the solution
text.id:
— 391 —

dari lain: tuang pada tutiya suci — ia tuang dan potong cret ratapnya; lalu tuang tutiya itu pada tembaga merah — memutihkan putih teguh. Campur dengan perak sesukamu, berguna dari harimu — itulah kerja terbaik. ( Cara lain lebih baik ) Ambil harqus Aleppo macam kacang; panaskan bót biasa celur minyak baik, madu lebah, sabun pukul air limau hijau; ambil 11 dirham, tambah 3 dirham hamba, 1 dirham kuning, 1 dirham batu qali — giling, bawa minyak natron, turun bót ke bót, turun anak ayam macam bintang; ambil 10 dirham Zuhrah kuning, 10 perak ditetapkan, tuang — datang kebenaran. Seorang Maghribi berkata: ambil natron merah sultan, kapur marmar sepadan, ada tambah qali, giling bakar periuk dapur 2 hari 2 malam, keluarkan gantung balang tertutup api dengan air tawar 3 kali ganti, masuk batu terkalsin sedikit demi sedikit air mendidih kuat hingga susut sepertiga — air selepas larut mendidih jadi air panas; suling pada hamba dengan bulu pelepah api beransur — pertama api sumbu, kedua ganda 3, ketiga ganda gandanya 3; rahsia pada api. Bila henti hamba ikat dua ikatan beri minum air, miliki darjah kemerahan dan merah — tiap baik hanya dari jenis dua batu itu. Ada yang ambil separuh itu panas macam api, giling 3 auns kala jatuh terus air seratl, jadi macam Laut Hitam; masuk 3 auns rambut uban larut; ulang air dari balang ke balang api dapur hingga rab membeku naik minyak kuning macam za'faran — keruk sudu. Ambil harqus Aleppo terbakar, panaskan celur minyak itu 21 kali, ambil satu auns dan marzan bertompok cerah sepadan, tuang — Bulan keluar sendiri dicelup macam emas. ( Rjaraj ) 60 hanthal potong pisau kayu; 2 ratl natron giling campur taruh penerima, jaga air; ambil ratl 'uqab bahagi 4, bahagi habuk bakar, keluarkan giling bahagian lain, hingga 4 bahagian lengkap — habuk merah. Ambil ratl hamba basuh air bijik sawi, salut putih telur basuh air panas; hampar habuk penutup alas, tenggelam air hanthal dalam cawan kaca lilin tanah di dapur tiup nyawa; bila susut tambah hingga mati putus rasa. Kalsin bót beri lilin rambut, tetap tak susut tak berubah. ( Salap mata kuat mudah ) Ambil batu mulia yang jadi zat, balasan ilahi, malam kanan, pelita terang, matahari ufuk dan penaklukan faham — pertama dan halus benda — rambut manusia, khususnya putingnya — apa jua gunting selepas basuh sabun tanah kering hingga turun tapis; ambil ratlnya, dan air kepala larut kaca. ( Vitriol ) Vitriol kuning baik giling taruh jug kaca tanah sambungan, tabur tapis mahir, bakar dapur panas, keluarkan giling lebur dengan larutan —

title.ar: تبييض النحاس بالقلعي ومزجه بالفضة
title.en: Whitening Copper with Qal'ī and Alloying with Silver
title.id: Memutihkan Tembaga dengan Tutiya dan Campur Perak

text.ar:
— ٣٩٢ —

ودسه ثاني ليلة وثالث ثم تحله في ماء الرأس واطبخه فيه حتى يأخذ صبغة قوية ثم تجره العلة، وتأخذ
بقدر الشعر المذكور منه وزنا بوزن وضع ماء الرأس على نار لينة في اناء مهون أوزاج وضع فيه
الشعر قليلا وخفضه ولا تزال تضع قليلا حتى ينحل الرطل الشعر في الرطل الماء المذكور ثم
قطره بلطف ماء حتى يقطر ماء أبيض مثل الفضة فإذا بدت الحمرة اقتلع القابلة وشمها وجد القابلة
بقابلة أخرى وعد الوصل ثم قو النار أقوى من الأولى فمن ذلك ينزل الدهن مثل الياقوت
الاحمر والزعفران الجوي فاحذر ان تمسه بيدك فانه يصبغ كل شئ مسه أصفر ثم يخرج منه ثم
اذا كل قطر شمعه وصنه من الهواء ثم بعد ذلك خذ الزنجفر الرماني واجعله في حبة صفراء واحدة
مهندمة وخذ وزن مثلها عقرا بأوزن ثلثها بني يسحقان ويعملان حبة بصفار البيض وتعمل في
قلب قدرة ملانة ملح طعام ثم تاخذ وصلها وتدمسها في نار قوية ولا تخف عنها وتفعل به هكذا
مرات تدميسات بخمس جيب وانت تحدد له في كل مرة الجهة والملح الذي في القدرة وتدمس
كما تقدم ثم اسحقه واطبخه بماء الرأس الابيض الذي حللت فيه الحجر في قنينة علية على النار اللينة
وتقد عليه النار حتى تظهر به ويكون الماء غمره أوأكبر وتصبر عليه حتى يجف ثم اسحقه جيدا
بالغا بتلك الدهنة الحمراء الرماني وهذا هو الدهن المعبر عنه باسمه عند أرباب الفن سقى وتشميع
على نار لينة والشمس أسلم عاقبة من النار الى أن تنفسح دمنته حمراء غير جامدة اهم الشخص
ونقط عليه من ذلك الدهن يديك اسحقه واسقه من الزنجفر المحلول بقدر وزنه مرتين ينحل ثم
اعقده واسحقه بالدهنة المستقطرة من الحجر حتى ينحل ثم نقط منه على شخوص الاسرب كما تقدم
وكل هنيئا مريئا * واعلم أن من أراد أن يصل الى العلم الكيميا الصحيح فليطهر وليصم ٤٠ يوما
متوالية بجنب الروح وما خرج منها ويفطر فيها على الحلال ويقرأ كل ليلة والشمس وضحاها
والليل إذا يغشى والضحى والم نشرح ٧ مرات وقل اللهم مالك الملك الى حساب ٤٠
مرة ثم تقول اللهم اني اسألك بقدرتك على كل شئ وتسخيرك لكل شئ يا احد يا صمد يا حي
يا قيوم أن تصلى على سيدنا محمد وان تسخر لي العلم الذي سترته على كثير من خلقك وأكرم به
كثيرا من عبادك يا كافي يا غني يا مغني يا فتاح يا هادي واغنني عمن سواك انك مالك الملك وبيدك
مقاليد السموات والارض وأنت على كل شئ قدير فاذا فعل ذلك سخر الله له من يرشده الى ما طلب
يقظة أومناما والله على كل شئ قدير

( الفصل الحادي والثلاثون في أعمال السيميا وجميع المقالات )
يروى عن آصف بن برخيا عن سليمان بن داود عليهما السلام وهي التي كان يعمل بها الحلاج وغيره
من أهل هذا الشأن * واعلم أن الخطفر يات هي العلم المصون وهو يروى عن سادة اجلاء
مثل الخوارزمي والسيد البهلول وآصف وسليمان وقد جمعها الحلاج رحمه الله في ١١ مقالة واعلم
أن أصل هذا العلم تدبيري روحاني إذا أردت العمل به فخذه ٤ لاتا عار ١٤ ٦ ليس فيه
إشارة بيضاء وتصوم ٣ أيام وتقرأ الخطفر يات ٢١ ثم تستقبل القبلة وتأخذ سكينا لها حدان
تذبحه بحد وتشق بطنه الآخر وحال ذبحك له تنادى بالخطفر يات ثم و لافي قدر جديد بخار
ولا
text.en:
— 392 —

And bury it a second night and a third, then dissolve it in the head-water and cook it in it until it takes a strong dye, then draw off the ailment. And you take of the mentioned hair the like of it, weight for weight, and place the head-water on a gentle fire in a earthenware vessel of glazed pottery, and place in it a little of the hair and lower it, and do not cease placing a little until the ratl of hair dissolves in the mentioned ratl of water. Then distill it gently with water until there distills a white water like silver; and when the redness appears, remove the receiver and scent it, and you find the receiver with another receiver, and renew the joint; then strengthen the fire stronger than the first, and from that there descends the grease like red ruby and aerial saffron — so beware of touching it with your hand, for it dyes everything it touches yellow, then it comes out of it. Then when it has all distilled, wax it and preserve it from the air. Then after that take the pomegranate zinjifar and put it in one trimmed yellow berry, and take the like of its weight of 'uqār with a third of its weight of bānī; they are ground and made into a berry with egg-yolk, and worked in the heart of a pot full of table-salt. Then you take its joint and embed it in a strong fire and do not fear for it, and do to it thus several times — embeddings with five pockets — and you determine for it each time the direction and the salt that is in the pot, and embed as preceded. Then grind it and cook it with the white head-water in which you dissolved the stone, in an upper flask on the gentle fire, and urge the fire upon it until it appears in it, and let the water submerge it or be greater, and be patient upon it until it dries; then grind it well, attaining with that red pomegranate grease. And this is the grease expressed by its name among the masters of the art — watering and waxing on a gentle fire, and the sun is safer in outcome than the fire, until its red blood spreads, not coagulated, and you anoint the persons with that grease — grind it and give to drink of the dissolved zinjifar the measure of its weight twice, and it dissolves; then coagulate it and grind it with the grease distilled from the stone until it dissolves; then drop of it upon the figures of lead as preceded, and eat wholesomely and digest. * And know that whoever wills to reach the sound science of alchemy, let him purify and fast 40 days in succession beside the spirit and what comes from it, and break his fast in it upon the lawful, and read every night "By the Sun and its forenoon" and "By the night when it covers" and "The Forenoon" and "Have We not opened" 7 times, and say "O Allah, Owner of the Dominion" up to "the Account" 40 times. Then you say: "O Allah, I ask You by Your power over everything and Your subjugation of everything — O Unique, O Eternal, O Living, O Self-Subsistent — that You bless our master Muhammad and subjugate to me the knowledge which You hid from many of Your creatures and honored thereby many of Your servants; O Sufficient, O Rich, O Enricher, O Opener, O Guide, and enrich me from other than You, for You are Owner of the Dominion and in Your hand are the keys of the heavens and the earth, and You are over everything powerful." So when he does that, Allah subjugates to him one who guides him to what he sought, awake or asleep — and Allah is over everything powerful.

( Chapter Thirty-One, on the works of Sīmiyā and all the treatises )
It is related from Āṣaf b. Barkhiyā from Solomon b. David, upon both of them peace — and it is that by which al-Ḥallāj and others of the people of this matter worked. * And know that al-khaṭfaryāt is the guarded science, and it is related from eminent masters like al-Khwārazmī and al-Sayyid al-Bahlūl and Āṣaf and Solomon; and al-Ḥallāj — may Allah have mercy on him — collected them in 11 treatises. And know that the root of this science is a spiritual management: when you will to work by it, take 4 lātā 'ār 14 6 — in which is no white sign — and fast 3 days and read al-khaṭfaryāt 21, then face the qibla and take a knife having two edges; slaughter it with one edge and slit its belly with the other, and while slaughtering it you call out with al-khaṭfaryāt, then — and in a new pot by steam —
text.id:
— 392 —

Kubur malam kedua dan ketiga, lalu larut di air kepala dan masak hingga dapat pewarna kuat, kemudian tapis penyakitnya. Ambil rambut disebut seberatnya, taruh air kepala di api lembut dalam bekas tembikar glazur, masuk sedikit rambut dan rendahkan, terus tambah hingga ratl rambut larut dalam ratl air. Suling perlahan hingga titis air putih macam perak; bila merah nampak, tanggal penerima dan hidu, ganti penerima lain, baharui sambungan; kuatkan api lebih dari pertama, turun gris macam delima merah dan za'faran udara — jangan sentuh tangan, ia celup kuning segala yang disentuh. Bila habis suling, lilin dan jauhkan udara. Ambil zinjifar delima taruh satu buah kuning terpangkas, timbang sepadan 'uqar sepertiga beratnya bani; giling buat buah dengan kuning telur, kerja dalam periuk penuh garam makan. Ambil sambungan tanam api kuat jangan takut, buat beberapa kali — tanam dengan lima poket — tentukan arah dan garam dalam periuk, tanam seperti disebut. Giling masak air kepala putih larut batu dalam flaskan atas api lembut, kuatkan api hingga nampak, air tenggelam atau lebih, sabar hingga kering; giling halus dengan gris delima merah itu. Inilah gris disebut namanya pada ahli seni — siram dan lilin api lembut, matahari lebih selamat dari api, hingga darah merah merebak tak beku, sapu pada orang dengan gris itu — giling beri minum zinjifar larut seberatnya dua kali larut; koagulasikan giling dengan gris batu suling hingga larut; titis pada tokoh plumbum seperti disebut, makan baik. * Barangsiapa mahu ilmu kimia sejati, hendaklah suci dan puasa 40 hari berturut di sisi roh dan keluarnya, berbuka dengan halal, baca tiap malam "Demi Matahari", "Demi Malam", "Dhuha", "Bukankah Kami" 7 kali, dan "Ya Allah Pemilik Kerajaan" hingga "Perhitungan" 40 kali. Lalu: "Ya Allah, kuminta dengan kuasaMu atas segala dan penundukanMu — Wahai Esa, Kekal, Hidup, Berdiri Sendiri — berkatilah Muhammad, tundukkan ilmu yang Kausembunyikan dari makhluk, muliakan hamba; Wahai Cukup, Kaya, Pemurah, Pembuka, Pemberi Petunjuk, cukupkan aku dari selainMu, Engkau Pemilik Kerajaan, kunci langit bumi di tanganMu." Maka Allah tundukkan padanya yang menunjukinya — jaga atau tidur.

( Bab 31 — Amal Sīmiyā dan segala maqalah )

And do not throw away aught of it nor of its blood; then you take of the swallows 13 or more singly and slaughter them and throw them in the pot, and let none of their blood come out of the pot, and seal that pot with the clay of wisdom and secure its joint, and kindle upon it the fire with willow wood until you know that what is inside the pot has burned and become charcoal. Then bring it down from the fire and set it on the ground until it cools, and open it while you turn your face away — for at the moment of opening there comes out of it a vapor like black smoke, and if it enter a human eye it blinds on the spot and has no cure. So be patient until that passes, and pound all that burned thing and place it by you on a tray until the time of need — and it is the root of this science. So when you will to work by it in anything, take of that mentioned ash a little and turn it between your hands and recite al-maḥnaṭṭiyāt once, and there becomes for what you pointed to of the hidden signs for every beholder of you. And know that the entering of the ash into those works and all you will is inevitable; so when you possess the ash you come out from the darkness of having no disposal to the light — and praise belongs to Allah. ( The First Treatise ) — it is treatise 11 majh — you take gazelle-skin and make of it a hood and write upon it what comes next with something of ink, then wear it on your head and supplicate with this supplication, and it is the supplication of al-maḥnaṭṭiyāt: "O Allah, I ask You by Your ancient Name — O Eternal, O Everlasting, O One, O Unique, O Single, O Eternal, O Who begets not nor is begotten and has not any equal — O Lord of lords, O Mighty, O Bestower, O Encompasser of the terror of the Day of Fear — I ask You to subjugate to me one of the servants of Your Name who serves me in what I will, for You are over everything powerful." And with it is a long discipline with its condition; then throw with you something of the mentioned ash, then read al-maḥnaṭṭiyāt 10 times until your shadow vanishes while you stand in the sun; and if any of the jinn or men passes by you, you see him and he sees you not, and likewise the beasts pass by you and see you not, nor hears your sound in walking. And this is what you write upon the hood with the mentioned ink — 4 lines — and the words upon it you say: "Wāh 2, hadāh 2, hīwah 2, halah 2, halūwah 2, halūliyāh 2, yūsh 2, wash 2, al-wāsh 2, ayyūsh 2, al-wash 2, shālish 2, ayyish 2, ahdān 2, awṭaf 2, laṭṭaf 2, lawṭāif 2, ṭāif 2 — come, O servants of these names, and hide me from the sights by the right of Allah the One, the Subduer, al-waḥā 2 — for that happens in the swiftest time; so understand and be guided." ( The Second Treatise ) The facing of reconciliation — and it has multiple names, and names 85811 are written on musk-paper and saffron with the mentioned ash, and you hold it in your hand, and everyone you point to is struck down; and if you point to a pregnant woman she drops what is in her belly, and the beasts throw their loads, and the mount overturns, and the horseman is struck down, and the arrow returns upon him who shot it, and likewise the striker and the thief and all you will. And this is what you write: "2, mīm wāḥah halah jah 999" — and the words upon it you say: "Abdāh dīwāh al-wāh āh āh ahiyāh lah ' ' ' lālā 364 wāw wāw ayyāsh ashmūwāsh ayyāsh al-waḥā al-'ajal al-sā'a tawakkalū yā khaddam ṭaḥ ḥ 181 99 33 66 111 75 111 15" — these names, and answer and hasten with such-and-such by the right of Him who says to a thing 'Be' and it is. ( The Third Treatise ) — and it is

Jangan buang apa pun darinya atau darahnya; ambil layang-layang 13 atau lebih satu-satu, sembelih dan campak dalam periuk, jangan biar darah keluar; tutup periuk dengan tanah hikmah dan ketatkan sambungan, nyalakan api kayu siput hingga dalam periuk hangus jadi arang. Turunkan dari api letak tanah hingga sejuk, buka sambil palingkan muka — bila dibuka keluar wap macam asap hitam, masuk mata buta serta-merta tiada ubat. Sabar hingga hilang, tumbuk serpihan taruh dulang sampai perlu — itulah asal ilmu ini. Bila mahu guna, ambil sedikit abu itu pusing di tangan bacakan mahnatiyat sekali, nampak tanda tersembunyi bagi tiap pemerhati. Wajib masuk abu dalam amalan; bila miliki abu keluar dari gelap tiada kuasa ke cahaya — segala puji bagi Allah. ( Maqalah 1 ) — maqalah 11 majh — ambil kulit kijang buat ketopong tulis dengan dakwat, pakai di kepala doa mahnatiyat: "Ya Allah, kuminta dengan namaMu purba — Wahai Kekal, Abadi, Esa, Unik, Tunggal, Kekal, Yang tidak beranak diperanakkan tiada banding — Wahai Tuhan semesta, Perkasa, Pemberi, Pemurah hari ketakutan — tundukkan padaku satu hamba namaMu yang berkhidmat, Engkau Maha Kuasa." Dengan riyadhah panjang; campak sedikit abu, baca mahnatiyat 10 kali hingga bayang hilang berdiri matahari; jin manusia lalu kau nampak ia tak nampak kau, binatang pun begitu tak dengar bunyi langkah. Ini yang ditulis pada ketopong 4 baris — katanya: "Wah 2, hadah 2, hiwah 2, halah 2, haluwah 2, haluliyah 2, yush 2, wash 2, al-wash 2, ayyush 2, al-wash 2, shalish 2, ayyish 2, ahdan 2, awtaf 2, lattaf 2, lawtaif 2, taif 2 — marilah wahai hamba nama ini, sembunyikan aku dari pandangan dengan hak Allah Esa Perkasa al-waha 2 — jadi segera; faham dan dapat petunjuk." And that is among the greatest magical laws, and by it they talismaned the waters inside treasures. And the like of it, if you wish to make the sea land and the reverse, then the ash and al-bahsī 5mh are thrown into the sea, and the earth and the foam on the land, and it is only by the side of the river bank, for it will appear to the onlookers that the sea has become land. So if you wish to nullify it, then call with the speech upon it 7, and a pillar of smoke will stand for you, so seek the nullification of that, and it will be nullified. And this is what you write on the potsherd: 11 ṣaḥ m 11 5818 aaaa 6 2 5 mh mh 44 4. If you do not have access to that, then take a basin or a wide vessel in which is water, and call with the Khunṭariyyāt once, and the barāmah in your hand, and throw some ash, then descend into it 5, you will be hidden from their eyes, and go wherever you wish, you will be saved. ( Amal ṭarī 51 ) Bila mahu, ambil pecahan bertanda 8 81, ṭaḥ lad ah mawqūfah, dan zubd al-baḥr, pergi ke padang, campak sedikit abu di hadapan, ke dua sisi belakang dan hadapan, tanah di kanan kiri, seru al-khanṭariyāt 7 — tempat itu jadi laut bergelombang, tak batal hingga kau angkat apa yang dikerja. Itu antara hukum sihir terbesar, dengannya mereka meterai (ṭalamsū) air dalam khazanah. Begitu juga bila mahu jadikan laut darat — dan sebaliknya — campak abu dan al-bahsī 5mah di laut, tanah dan zubd di darat, hanya di tepi tebing sungai, nampak pada pemerhati laut jadi darat. Bila mahu batalkan, seru kata padanya 7, berdiri tiang asap; minta pembatalan maka batal. Ini yang ditulis pada pecahan: 11, ṣaḥ m 11, 5818, aaaa 6 2 5, mah mah 44 4 — katanya: "Iyāh 2, ahih ṣabā annanā adhniya adlihīyūn 1251, ahdinā huwāh naw kalū — dengan sekian, wahai hamba nama ini."

( Maqalah 4 ) Untuk lepaskan tahanan dan sesiapa dalam urusan berat: lukis rupa ṭṭ 8 — rupa lengkap kelengkapan — dalam tanah dasar penjara, naik kepadanya seru al-khanṭariyāt 7 kali, campak sedikit abu di tangan, hulur tangan ke arah khadam — ia angkat dan terbang bawamu ke mana jua. Bila tiada akses, ambil b basin atau bekas luas berair, seru al-khanṭariyāt sekali, burāmah di tangan, campak abu, turun ke dalam 5 tak — tersembunyi dari mata mereka, pergi ke mana mahu selamat. Ini yang ditulis: 44 5 6 7 8 9 7 — katanya: "Aydamāh yārūḥ lawāh, ah 2, ah lahu lahūh, ajib ṭā'iman, buat sekian — jadi."

( Maqalah 5 ) Ambil lilin celup hijau tembaga, ambil kain — tulis nama ini pintal jadi sumbu, pakai dengan lilin hijau; ambil b tinah tembaga berair, tegakkan lilin nyalakan jauhkan, tabur abu, seru al-khanṭariyāt hingga nampak merak hijau datang dari segala tempat, main tepuk sayap jerit kuat, berterusan hingga sumbu habis. ( The Ninth Treatise ) You go to the open and make around you the circle; you sit 5 117 ṭ ' 1 ṭ 9 in it, and throw between your hands some of the ash around the circle from outside, and speak 1999 1001 177 with the words, and write the names on a burāwah and hang it on a pomegranate-stick — and all 1911 1114 ṭ 2 of the wild beasts and creeping things of the open attend you and do not harm you; take of them what you will and leave of them what you will, and dismiss them — you pull the burāwah from the stick. And this is its writing as you see. And the words upon it you say: "Āh ayyuh ayyuh abadan al-waḥā, al-'ajal al-sā'a — may Allah bless you." ( The Tenth Treatise ) You take a knife and write upon it the names of the ash, then take a reed and give it to whom you will to slaughter it with that knife; and when he takes it, speak the words and command him to draw the knife upon it and throw upon the reed some of the ash, and throw it from his hand — and it flies toward the sky like a rooster that crows and cackles and disturbs everyone who sees it. And this is what you write upon the knife on the first face: "this 1111119996111 k 5 wa-fiyāthā hādhā, 99 ṭ ' lā 100111 awj" — and the words upon it you say after throwing the mentioned ash: "Ishār shawshār shārāis asā ashālīsh, ajib wa'jal bikadhā wakadhā — may Allah bless you, and upon you peace." ( The Eleventh Treatise ) You take a copper cup and engrave upon it these names and fill it with water and speak upon it with this speech — and it becomes obedient to what he commanded, 7 ' ṭ. And thus you do with the tablet aḥ l mās, red skin — and this writing is upon the dirhams and dinars (the first face): "92 k wah" (and the second face): "aḥ 111111113 ḥ ṭ 1119111 ḥ" — and the words upon it you say: "Ṣāṣiyā lahr as, ajib wa'jal, and sprinkle upon them the ash — and all we mentioned comes to be; so admonish and verify, and be guided to the clearest path." And in the beginning of the work of Sīmiyā there must be long discipline and fasting and seclusion, and you attain what you will — and Allah is the One who grants success. And may Allah bless our master Muhammad and his family and companions and grant peace.

( End of the Third Part of the book Shams al-Ma'ārif al-Kubrā by al-Būnī, and following it the Fourth Part, whose beginning is
Chapter Thirty-Eight, on the uses of the letters and the secrets they bear )
text.id:
- 395 -

daripada itu — bahkan ia berpaling lari darimu. Inilah rupa tulisan burāwah: "ḥ ḥ 111116 hā 149 k 5" — katanya: "Bihadhā amā wahuwa lā 75 ahwāh 2, ajib 26699 111 a 1799 k 1 — segera, semoga Allah memberkati." ( Maqalah 8 ) Tulis nama ini pada burāwah gantung pada cawan dengan abu, katanya, campak ke sungai — segala ikan berkumpul; ambil mana jua. Mata tengah baris kedua berhadapan mata baris pertama begini. Katanya: "Jamī'an lillahiyyāh, ajib wa'jal sekian — semoga Allah memberkati, 711 ṭ ṭ ' 11 ṭ — sejahtera atasmu." ( Maqalah 9 ) Pergi padang buat bulatan sekeliling; duduk 5 117 ṭ ' 1 ṭ 9, campak abu luar bulatan, ucap 1999 1001 177, tulis nama burāwah gantung pada dahan delima — segala 1911 1114 ṭ 2 binatang liar datang padamu tak mudarat; ambil tinggal, suruh balik — cabut burāwah dari dahan. Inilah tulisannya. Katanya: "Āh ayyuh ayyuh abadan al-waḥā, segera — semoga Allah memberkati." ( Maqalah 10 ) Ambil pisau tulis nama abu, ambil buluh beri pada sesiapa menyembelih; bila pegang, ucap kata suruh gerak pisau campak abu pada buluh, lempar dari tangan — terbang ke langit macam ayam jantan berkokok mengganggu tiap pemerhati. Ini yang ditulis pada pisau muka pertama: "ini 1111119996111 k 5 wa-fiyāthā hādhā, 99 ṭ ' lā 100111 awj" — katanya selepas campak abu: "Ishār shawshār shārāis asā ashālīsh, ajib wa'jal sekian — semoga Allah memberkati, sejahtera atasmu." ( Maqalah 11 ) Ambil cawan tembaga ukir nama isi air ucap kata — jadi patuh perintah, 7 ' ṭ. Begitu juga kepingan aḥ l mās kulit merah — tulisan pada dirham dinar (muka pertama): "92 k wah" (muka kedua): "aḥ 111111113 ḥ ṭ 1119111 ḥ" — katanya: "Ṣāṣiyā lahr as, ajib wa'jal, tabur abu — segala disebut jadi; nasihat dan sahih, dapat jalan nyata." Mula amal Sīmiyā mesti riyadhah panjang, puasa, mengasingkan diri, capai apa dikehendaki — Allah pemberi taufiq. Semoga Allah berkat Muhammad keluarga sahabatnya dan sejahtera.

( Tamat Bahagian Ketiga Shams al-Ma'ārif al-Kubrā karya al-Būnī, disusuli Bahagian Keempat bermula
Bab 38 — Kegunaan huruf dan rahsianya )

text.ar:
الجزء الرابع
من كتاب
شمس المعارف
الكبرى
ولطائف العوارف

للشيخ أحمد بن علي البوني قدس الله روحه المتوفى سنة ٦٢٢ اثنين وعشرين وستمائة
قال في كشف الظنون والمقصود من هذا الكتاب أن يعلم بذلك شرف أسماء الله تعالى وما أودع
في بحرها من أنواع الجواهر الحكميات وكيف التصريف بالأسماء والدعوات وما تابعها
من حروف السور والآيات ليتصل بها إلى الحضرة الربانية من غير تعب ويتصل بها إلى
رغائب الدنيا بلا نصب انتهى

ويليه
رسالة ميزان العدل في مقاصد أحكام الرمل * ورسالة فوائح الرغائب في خصوصيات
أوقات الكواكب * ورسالة زهر المروج في دلائل البروج * ورسالة لطائف الإشارة
في خصائص الكواكب السيارة * تأليف العلامة الفاضل السيد عبد القادر الحسيني الأدهمي
* نفع الله بعلومه المسلمين آمين

تنبيه
حيث إن كتاب شمس المعارف لشدة احتياج الناس إليه طبع مراراً (بمصر والهند) وقد
اعتنت المطابع المصرية بتصحيحه لكنه لم يخل من غلط وتحريف لعدم وجود نسخ صحيحة
وقد طبع هذه المرة مقابلاً على نسخ « مصر والهند » ونسخة أخرى بخط الحاج مرزا حسين
مع الدقة في التصحيح بمعرفة لجنة من أفاضل علماء مصر وأعاد تصحيحها الأستاذ الكبير الشيخ
عبد الرحمن الجويزي فجاءت بحمد الله هذه النسخة من أجل النسخ طبعاً وتصحيحاً

طبع بمطبعة
مصطفى البابي الحلبي وأولاده بمصر
text.en:
The Fourth Part
of the book
Shams al-Ma'ārif
al-Kubrā
and Latā'if al-'Awārif

by the Shaykh Aḥmad b. 'Alī al-Būnī — may Allah sanctify his spirit — who died in the year 622 (twenty-two and six hundred)
He said in Kashf al-Ẓunūn: "The aim of this book is that one thereby know the nobility of the Beautiful Names of Allah, exalted is He, and what He deposited in Their ocean of the kinds of wisdom-jewels, and how to dispose by the Names and the invocations and what follows them of the letters of the sūrahs and verses, so as to reach by them the Lordly Presence without toil, and to reach by them the desires of this world without exertion" — end quote.

And following it:
the Treatise of the Balance of Justice on the aims of the rulings of sand-divination * and the Treatise of the Breaths of Desires on the specialities of the times of the planets * and the Treatise of the Blossom of Meadows on the proofs of the zodiacal signs * and the Treatise of the Subtleties of Allusion on the special properties of the wandering planets * by the composition of the excellent illustrious savant al-Sayyid 'Abd al-Qādir al-Ḥusaynī al-Adhamī * — may Allah benefit the Muslims by his sciences, amen.

A note:
Whereas the book Shams al-Ma'ārif, because of the people's great need of it, has been printed repeatedly (in Egypt and India), and the Egyptian presses took care to correct it, yet it was not free of error and alteration for lack of sound copies — and this time it has been printed collated against the copies of "Egypt and India" and another copy in the hand of the Pilgrim Marzā Ḥusayn, with precision in correction under the knowledge of a committee of the excellent scholars of Egypt, and the great master the Shaykh 'Abd al-Raḥmān al-Jawzī re-corrected it — so by the praise of Allah this copy has come out among the finest copies in printing and correction.

Printed at the press of
Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī and his sons, in Egypt
text.id:
Bahagian Keempat
kitab
Shams al-Ma'ārif
al-Kubrā
dan Latā'if al-'Awārif

karya Shaykh Aḥmad bin 'Alī al-Būnī — semoga Allah sucikan ruhnya — wafat tahun 622 (dua puluh dua enam ratus)
Beliau berkata dalam Kashf al-Ẓunūn: "Tujuan kitab ini ialah supaya diketahui kemuliaan Nama-nama Allah yang Indah, dan apa yang ditempatkan dalam lautan-Nya dari jenis permata hikmah, dan bagaimana bertasaruf dengan Nama dan doa serta huruf surah ayat yang mengikutinya, sehingga sampai kepada Hadirat Ilahi tanpa lelah, dan capai keinginan dunia tanpa susah" — tamat.

Dan menyusulinya:
Risalah Mīzān al-'Adl pada maksud hukum ramalan pasir * Risalah Fawā'iḥ al-Raghā'ib pada khusus waktu planet * Risalah Zahr al-Murūj pada dalil buruj * Risalah Laṭā'if al-Ishārah pada sifat khusus planet beredar * karya al-Sayyid 'Abd al-Qādir al-Ḥusaynī al-Adhamī * — semoga Allah manfaatkan ilmunya bagi Muslimin, amin.

Peringatan:
Oleh kerana kitab Shams al-Ma'ārif sangat diperlukan orang, telah dicetak berulang (di Mesir dan India), dan cetakan Mesir menjaga pembetulan, namun tidak terlepas dari salah tahrif kerana tiada salinan sahih — kali ini dicetak disemak dengan salinan "Mesir dan India" dan salinan tulisan tangan Marzā Ḥusayn, dengan teliti di bawah jawatankuasa ulama Mesir, dan guru besar Shaykh 'Abd al-Raḥmān al-Jawzī menyemak semula — maka dengan puji Allah naskhah ini terbaik cetak dan betulan.

Dicetak di matba'
Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī dan anak-anaknya, di Mesir

وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ

( الْفَصْلُ الثَّامِنُ وَالثَّلَاثُونَ فِي اسْتِخْدَامِ الْحُرُوفِ وَخَلْوَاتِهَا وَمَالَهَا مِنَ الْأَسْرَارِ )
۞ اعْلَمْ وَفَّقَكَ اللَّهُ وَإِيَّاكَ أَنَّ حَرْفَ الْأَلِفِ هُوَ أَوَّلُ مَخْلُوقٍ خُلِقَ مِنَ الْحُرُوفِ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ فِي الْعَدَدِ
لِأَنَّ مِنْهُ أَسْرَارَ الْأَقْوَالِ كَمَا أَنَّ الْحُرُوفَ مِنْ أَسْرَارِ الْأَفْعَالِ وَأَنَّ الْحُرُوفَ لَا وَقْتَ لَهَا يَحْصُرُهَا وَإِنَّمَا
هِيَ تَفْعَلُ بِالْخَاصَّةِ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ وَهَذَا الْحَرْفُ مِنْ أَثِيرِ الِارْتِقَاءِ إِلَى دَرَجَاتِ الْوَاصِلِينَ الْوَارِثِينَ
وَمَنْ تَحَقَّقَ مَا فِي عَوَالِمِهِ الظَّاهِرَةِ وَالْبَاطِنَةِ اسْتَخْدَمَ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعَ مَا فِي الْكَوْنِ وَهَذَا يُشْبِهُ نَعِيمَ
الْجَنَّةِ ۞ وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ الْأَلِفَ زُبْدَةُ الْعَالَمِ وَالْغَايَةُ الْقُصْوَى بَلْ هِيَ مَرْجِعُ كُلِّ عَالَمٍ سِرُّ التَّكْوِينِ
وَقِيَامِ الْأَلِفِ مِنْ أَسْرَارِ اسْمِهِ الْقَيُّومِ وَهِيَ أَوَّلُ اسْمِ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمِ وَأَوَّلُ الْفَاتِحَةِ وَأَوَائِلِ السُّوَرِ وَهِيَ
حَرْفٌ نُورَانِيٌّ قَائِمٌ بِنَفْسِهِ أُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْأُمَمِ وَلَهُ أَعْمَالٌ كَثِيرَةٌ بِغَيْرِ خَلْوَةٍ وَاسْتِخْدَامٍ وَأَعْمَالٌ بِهِمَا وَأَعْمَالٌ
الْخَاصَّةِ فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ بِيَدِ الطَّبْعِ إِذَا كَتَبَ الْأَلِفَ مَرَّةً فِي خِرْقَةِ حَرِيرٍ وَعَلَّقَ عَلَى صَدْرِ الْبَلِيدِ
فَتَقَ ذِهْنُهُ وَحَفِظَ كُلَّ مَا سَمِعَ وَإِذَا كَتَبَ حَرْفَ الْأَلِفِ عَدَدَهَا الْأَصْلِيَّ وَهُوَ ١١١ وَرَبَطْتَ مَعَ
اسْمِكَ وَاسْمِ مَنْ تُرِيدُ وَحَمَلْتَهَا مَعَكَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْطِفُهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيُسَهِّلُ لَكَ الْأُمُورَ الصَّعْبَةَ وَإِذَا كَتَبْتَ
الْأَلِفَ مَعَ اسْمِ الطَّالِبِ وَالْمَطْلُوبِ وَرَبَطَ الِاسْمَيْنِ مَعَ الْحَرْفِ يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ سَاعَةَ الشَّمْسِ وَيَحْمِلُهَا فَإِنَّهُ
يَرَى مِنْهُ مَا يُرِيدُ مِنَ الْأَلْفَةِ وَالْمَحَبَّةِ وَالْقَبُولِ وَإِذَا كَتَبَ حَرْفَ الْأَلِفِ عَلَى خَاتَمِ ذَهَبٍ وَالْقَمَرُ فِي
الْحُوتِ وَجَمَعْتَهُ بِإِضْمَارِ الْأَحْرُفِ الْآتِيَةِ وَدَعَوْتَهُ وَكَتَبَ اسْمَ صَاحِبِ الْحَرْفِ كَانَ قَبُولًا لِكُلِّ مَنْ
حَمَلَهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْأَكَابِرِ وَهَذِهِ صُورَتُهُ بِالْوَجْهِ الثَّانِي

وَذَا
text.en:
And to Allah belong the Beautiful Names, so call upon Him by them.

In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

( Chapter Thirty-Eighth, on the employment of the letters and their spiritual retreats, and what secrets they bear )
[§] Know — may Allah grant you success, and you alone — that the letter Alif is the first created thing created of the letters, and it is the One in number; for from it are the secrets of sayings, just as the letters are from the secrets of deeds; and the letters have no time that encloses them — rather they act by the special property for whomsoever Allah wills that. And this letter is of the quintessence of the ascent to the degrees of the watchers (al-wāṣilīn), the inheritors; and whoever realizes what is in its manifest and hidden worlds employs, by the grace of Allah, all that is in existence — and this resembles the bliss of Paradise. [§] And know that the Alif is the cream of the world and the furthest goal; nay, it is the return of every world — the secret of origination. And the standing of the Alif is from the secrets of His Name al-Qayyūm; and it is the first of the Greatest Name of Allah, and the first of the Fātiḥah, and the firsts of the sūrahs; and it is a light-giving letter, standing by itself, a nation among nations, and it has many works without retreat and employment, and works with both, and special works. Among them, by the hand of nature: when you write the Alif once on a silk rag and hang it on the breast of the dullard, his intellect opens and he remembers all he heard. And when you write the letter Alif its original count — which is 111 — and bind with it your name and the name of whom you will, and carry it with you, Allah turns him toward you and eases for you the difficult matters. And when you write the Alif with the name of the seeker and the sought, and bind the two names with the letter on Sunday at the hour of the Sun, and carry it, he sees from it what he wills of affinity, love, and acceptance. And when you write the letter Alif on a gold ring while the Moon is in Pisces, and join it with the implicit concentration of the coming letters, and invoke it, and write the name of the master of the letter, it is acceptance for everyone who carries it among all the great ones. And this is its figure on the second face.

And this —
text.id:
Dan bagi Allah nama-nama yang indah, maka serulah Dia dengannya.

Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pemurah lagi Maha Penyayang.

( Bab 38 — Penggunaan huruf dan khalwatnya, serta rahsia yang ada padanya )
[§] Ketahuilah — semoga Allah memberi taufiq kepadamu — bahawa huruf Alif adalah makhluk pertama dicipta dari huruf, dan ia Satu dalam bilangan; darinya rahsia kata-kata sebagaimana huruf dari rahsia perbuatan; huruf tiada masa yang membatasinya — ia berkesan dengan sifat khas bagi sesiapa Allah kehendaki. Huruf ini inti pendakian ke darjat para wasil pewaris; sesiapa haqqiki apa dalam alam zahir batinnya, menguasai dengan kurnia Allah segala di alam — menyerupai nikmat syurga. [§] Alif adalah inti dunia dan matlamat tertinggi; bahkan kembali setiap alam — rahsia kejadian. Tegaknya Alif dari rahsia nama al-Qayyūm; ia permulaan Ism Allah teragung, permulaan al-Fātiḥah, permulaan surah; huruf bercahaya berdiri sendiri, satu umat, banyak amalan tanpa khalwat, dengan khalwat, dan amalan khusus. Antaranya: bila tulis Alif sekali pada kain sutera gantung di dada si bodoh, terbuka fikirnya ingat segala didengar. Tulis Alif bilangan asalnya 111 ikat nama sendiri dan nama dikehendaki, bawa bersama — Allah condongkan dia padamu mudahkan urusan sukar. Tulis Alif dengan nama pencari dan dicari, ikat dua nama dengan huruf hari Ahad jam Matahari, bawa — nampak apa dikehendaki dari mesra kasih penerimaan. Tulis Alif pada cincin emas bulan di Pisces, gabung dengan idmar huruf akan datang, doa, tulis nama pemilik huruf — penerimaan bagi semua yang membawa dari kalangan besar. Inilah rupanya pada muka kedua.

Dan ini —
