text.en:
— 510 —

"…And know that who is realized by the repentance of a people is he who repents from the people and reforms — he is brought out from the righteous and the disobedient, and they are upon that state according to their establishment in the apparent and hidden repentance, as related from al-Junayd in the Oneness. And know that the repentance is the going out from every blameworthy character and the entering into every praiseworthy character, and there is no praiseworthy but what the lawgiver delimited and approved — so at times it is by an inner aversion without remembrance and without known, for the Truth the Exalted draws him a draw and absorbs him in the seas of the obediences — so that is the one repenting upon it. And the drawing near to Allah the Exalted by this name is [that one] is patient in ease and hardship; and this name has no specific mention, and it has a square of great measure — invoke by it for the hearts to be sound and preserved, and for everyone afflicted by a calamity: so if it is written and given to drink to who was afflicted by a calamity — a child or wealth — Allah the Exalted sets right his state and makes patient his heart and eases for him the difficult matters. And this is its figure. And know — may Allah set right us and you in His obedience — that we have expounded the Beautiful Names, the ninety-nine, as they came in the report mentioned before, and we repeated in it the writing in our book 'The Pen of Guidance and the Ember of the Right-Direction,' and expounded in it the names upon other than this order — we mentioned in it every name and its retreat and its servant and what is specific to it in realization, that upon the way of the time and the appropriateness, as some of them said: 'Indeed this matter in itself is rare of aim, hard of attainment, profound of comprehension — for it is in the highest summit and the most excellent goal, which bewilders the possessors of intellect.' (A benefit) If the mounted journeys witnessed it, the men would not be generous with them; and you have heard of it and other than it in this book — and it is that to Allah the Exalted are ninety-nine names, and there falls to me in each year a name of them, so upon this the names are nine hundred and ninety from the migration of the Prophet by nine hundred and ninety cycles; and the excess of the thousand is ten to the date of the year fifty-two — so count from the Beautiful Names to al-Mumīt, and it is its completion; and the year 53 is a tool of deficiency, manifesting by His name al-Ḥayy (and it is JARRA); so when He manifests by His name al-Qābiḍ or al-Mumīt, the perishing falls in the creatures; and when He manifests by His name al-Rāziq and al-Fattāḥ, the good and the profit and the abundant fertility occur. And more than this cannot be declared; and Allah is the granter of success. And may Allah bless our master Muḥammad and his family and his companions and grant peace. (Chapter Forty: in the supplications answered, invoked by them at all times) And I open from them by His two names the Exalted, al-'Alīm al-Ḥakīm — so whoever perseveres in their mention, Allah eases for him what he wills and the understanding of the wisdom and the divine craft. And as for His names the Exalted al-Qarīb al-Khabīr — it is for who wants to open the door of the unveiling and the secrets, and it is of the attribution of Isrāfīl (peace be upon him); and His name al-Mubīn suits Jibrīl; and His name al-Hādī suits Isrāfīl (peace be upon him). And as for His names the Exalted al-Hādī al-Khabīr 'Allām al-Ghuyūb — so whoever mentions these names receives the prophethood its secrets and the gnostics their knowledges; so whoever wants the knowledge of the consequences of the affairs, let him fast and stay awake and mention these names, and say at the head of every hundred: 'Guide me, O Guide; inform me, O Aware; clarify for me, O Manifest; teach me, O Knower of the unseen.' And he hears what he wills in the depth of the night; and if sleep overtakes him, it is depicted for him in his dream in whatever kind he wills, as he willed. And whoever wants to have command over the lands and obedience — let him much constantly mention His name al-Hādī and take it as a mention and expand it, and break it with a name of who he wills to be submissive to him and ruled in him and be at his disposal as he wills. And the description of the breaking (taksīr) is thus: [page ends]

[The taksīr figure of al-Bāqī — 3 columns ال بو r: row 1 = 9 / 199 / 32 / 89; row 2 = 198 / 6 / 92 / 22; row 3 = 91 / 34 / 197 / 7] (this is the 'breaking' square that follows the taksīr description)
text.id:
— 510 —

"…Dan ketahuilah bahwa yang di-real-isasi dengan taubat suatu kaum ialah ia yang bertaubat dari kaum dan membaiki — ia dikeluarkan dari soleh dan maksiat, dan mereka atas keadaan itu menurut penetapan mereka dalam taubat nyata dan tersembunyi, sebagaimana diriwayatkan dari al-Junayd dalam tauhid. Dan ketahuilah bahwa taubat ialah keluar dari setiap akhlak tercela dan masuk ke dalam setiap akhlak terpuji, dan tiada terpuji melainkan apa yang ditentukan dan dipuji pembuat syariat — maka kadang dengan kejengkelan batin tanpa ingatan dan tanpa diketahui, kerana al-Ḥaqq Yang Maha Tinggi menarik satu tarikan dan menenggelamkannya dalam laut ketaatan — maka itu yang bertaubat atasnya. Dan mendekat kepada Allah Yang Maha Tinggi dengan nama ini ialah [yang] sabar dalam senang dan susah; dan nama ini tiada dzikir khusus, serta mempunyai segi empat berukuran agung — berdoalah dengannya agar hati sihat dan terpelihara, dan bagi setiap yang ditimpa musibah: maka bila ditulis dan diberi minum pada yang ditimpa musibah — anak atau harta — Allah Yang Maha Tinggi membaiki keadaannya serta menyabarkan hatinya dan memudahkan urusan sukar. Dan ini gambarannya. Dan ketahuilah — semoga Allah membaiki kami dan kamu dalam ketaatan-Nya — bahwa kami telah menjelaskan Asma' al-Ḥusnā, sembilan puluh sembilan, sebagaimana datang dalam riwayat yang disebut dahulu, dan kami ulangi padanya penulisan dalam kitab kami 'Pena Petunjuk dan Bara Petunjuk,' serta menjelaskan padanya nama-nama dengan susunan selain ini — kami sebut padanya tiap nama dan khalwatnya serta khadamnya dan apa yang khusus baginya dalam realisasi, itu atas jalan waktu dan kesesuaian, sebagaimana sebahagian mereka berkata: 'Sesungguhnya urusan ini pada dirinya jarang dicapai, sukar diperolehi, dalam difahami — kerana ia di puncak tertinggi dan matlamat terbaik yang membingungkan orang berakal.' (Faedah) Jika perjalanan berkendera menyaksikannya, manusia tidak akan bermurah dengannya; dan engkau telah dengar daripadanya dan selainnya dalam kitab ini — dan ia bahwa bagi Allah Yang Maha Tinggi sembilan puluh sembilan nama, dan jatuh kepadaku pada tiap tahun satu nama daripadanya, maka atas ini nama sembilan ratus sembilan puluh dari hijrah Nabi dengan sembilan ratus sembilan puluh pusingan; dan lebih dari seribu ialah sepuluh hingga tarikh tahun lima puluh dua — maka hitunglah dari Asma' al-Ḥusnā hingga al-Mumīt, dan ia penyempurnaannya; dan tahun 53 ialah alat kekurangan, menzahirkan dengan nama-Nya al-Ḥayy (dan ia JARRA); maka bila Ia menzahirkan dengan nama-Nya al-Qābiḍ atau al-Mumīt, fana jatuh pada makhluk; dan bila Ia menzahirkan dengan nama-Nya al-Rāziq dan al-Fattāḥ, kebaikan dan keuntungan serta kesuburan banyak terjadi. Dan lebih dari ini tidak dapat dinyatakan; dan Allah ialah Yang Memberi Taufik. Dan semoga Allah memberkati junjungan kami Muḥammad dan keluarga serta sahabatnya dan Memberi salam. (Fasal Keempat Puluh: dalam doa yang mustajab, yang dipohon padanya pada segala masa) Dan aku buka daripadanya dengan dua nama-Nya Yang Maha Tinggi, al-'Alīm al-Ḥakīm — maka barangsiapa bertekun dzikirnya, Allah memudahkan baginya apa yang dikehendaki serta pemahaman hikmah dan kerajinan ketuhanan. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Maha Tinggi al-Qarīb al-Khabīr — ia bagi yang mahu membuka pintu kasyaf dan rahsia, dan ia dari nisbah Isrāfīl a.s.; dan nama-Nya al-Mubīn sesuai Jibrīl; dan nama-Nya al-Hādī sesuai Isrāfīl a.s. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Maha Tinggi al-Hādī al-Khabīr 'Allām al-Ghuyūb — maka barangsiapa menyebut nama ini menerima kenabian rahsianya dan ahli ma'rifat ilmu mereka; maka barangsiapa mahu ilmu akibat urusan, hendaklah ia berpuasa dan berjaga serta menyebut nama ini, dan berkata di hujung tiap seratus: 'Berilah petunjuk, wahai Pemberi Petunjuk; beritahu aku, wahai Yang Mengetahui; jelaskan untukku, wahai Yang Menyatakan; ajarkan aku, wahai Yang Mengetahui yang Ghaib.' Dan ia dengar apa yang dikehendaki dalam tengah malam; dan bila tidur memegangnya, ia digambarkan dalam mimpinya apa jua jenis dikehendaki, sebagaimana dikehendaki. Dan barangsiapa mahu berkuasa atas negeri dan ketaatan — hendaklah ia memperbanyak sentiasa menyebut nama-Nya al-Hādī serta menjadikannya dzikir dan meluaskannya, dan memecahkannya dengan nama siapa dikehendaki agar tunduk kepadanya dan diurus padanya serta di bawah tangannya sebagaimana dikehendaki. Dan sifat pemecahan (taksīr) ialah demikian: [halaman berakhir]

[Segi empat taksīr al-Bāqī — 3 lajur ال بو r: baris 1 = 9 / 199 / 32 / 89; baris 2 = 198 / 6 / 92 / 22; baris 3 = 91 / 34 / 197 / 7] (ini segi empat 'pemecahan' yang menyusul keterangan taksīr)

title.ar: حقيقة التوبة ومقاماتها عند العارفين كالجنيد
title.en: The Reality of Repentance and Its Stations Among the Gnostics Like al-Junayd
title.id: Hakikat Taubat dan Maqam-maqamnya dalam Kalangan Arifin seperti al-Junayd

text.ar:
- ٥١١ -

(الْعَلِيُّ الْقَادِرُ الْبَاقِي) ثم يكسره مزجاً إلى أن يخرج السطر الأول آخراً ويكتبه في رق طاهر
دَعَامَةٌ لَهُ هَادِي أو كاغد ويترك السطر الأخير لأنه السطر الأول يصير مكرراً ويبخره ببخور
طيب ويحمله ويكثر من ذكر اسمه الهادي في قيامه وقعوده وعلى رأس كل مائة يقول ياهادي من
استهدى اهد فلان بن فلانة وأجله طوع يدي ومكني من ناصيته وقلبه ويكون ذلك يوم
الخميس أول ساعة ويكتب هذا المربع في الوجه الثاني ويحمله يحصل المطلوب وهذه صورته
| ٦٤٩ | ٥٦٤ | ١٦٥ | ٦٥٧ |
| ٦٦١ | ٦٥٦ | ٦٥٠ | ٥٦٢ |
| ٦٥٥ | ٦٥٨ | ٦٥٥ | ٥١ |
| ٦٦٤ | ٦٠٢ | ٦٥٤ | ٦٥٩ |
ويقرأ عليه هذا الدعاء تقول يارب صفِّ من كدورات الأغيار صفاه من
صفة بدعايتك وقربني إليك واحفظني من نقص التكوين حتى يتجلى في
مرآة قلبي ومس نفسي كل أهم اطبع في قوة جبريل عليه السلام فأتقوى
به على كشف ما في اللوح المحفوظ من أسرار أمهاتك ومجامع رسائلك إذ كل
نفس امتدت لها من رقائقها طرفها منه والثاني لمن هي له ومجامع هذه الرقائق في رقية الأمم
الخبير يلي العلم العليم العلام إذا الكرم الذي عم بالفم فؤاد الوحي والإلهام والحديث والفهم
يسري مني بنفحة منه في هذه الساعة إلى مثلها إلهي انطقني بالرقيقة العظمى حتى أتلقى منك
مالا تملأ به وجودي حتى أتلذذ بمصافاتك الملتذ جبريل برسالتك إنك أنت علام الغيوب قوله الحق
وله الملك الآية ياهادي يارشيد ياعلام الغيوب ياعلم الخفيات يا الله يارب العالمين من دعا بهذا الدعاء
٢٥ مرة بعد صلاة ركعتين ألهم رشده في عوالم الأمور وهو الكبير ذي الأحر فقس عليه وقدره
تجده [~] للفظ والعظم في معناه وهو اسم من أسماء الله تعالى العظيمة لأن السر كله في سرعة الإجابة
ويناسبه من آي القرآن العظيم قوله تعالى وعنده مفاتح الغيب إلى قوله مبين وأما اسمه الخبير
فمن ذكره سبعة أيام متوالية يأتيه الروحانية بكل خبر يريد من أخبار السنة وأخبار الملوك وأخبار
الغائب وأما اسمه تعالى المبين فمن ذكره كل يوم ألف مرة في خلوة على خلو معدة من الطعام ويبخر
ببخور طيب فإن جميع الأرواح تعطف عليه فيألف منها ما أراد ويبرك ما أراد وذلك عند طلوع
الشمس واستقام بدنه واعتدلت طبائعه وسمت روحه وحكم بأنواع الحكم التي لا يدركها غيره
وهذه جملة من أسماء الله تعالى هو الله الذي لا إله إلا هو العليم العلام الغيوب الحكيم الخبير
الحافظ الرقيب المبين الهادي وهي عشرة أسماء الذات وطاهم عظم في حفظ ماعسر عليك حفظه
وتزيد عليها قوله الحق وله الملك الآية وهو ذكر للذين فتح عليهم باب القرب في التوفيق
والمعارف فإنهم ذلك فإنه من استدام ذكره ألهم إلى علوم جليلة ويخاطب من نفسه باللغات من
الإلهام ويخاطبونه ويستفيد علوماً دقيقة ويخاطبه الحيوان يمهى يفهمه وفيه تأثير عظيم في فهم
المشكلات والتلاوة في ساعة المشتري لأنه من القول ذكر المنسيات من العلوم وحفظ سائرها
وأذكار المودة القديمة والحث على حفظها والتودد إلى الحكماء وأهل الخير والصنائع من
الناس وجمعهم على الخير واحذر أن يكون القمر في النحوس فإن هذه الأسماء مناسبة لما ذكرنا
وفيها منبع العلوم وأصول المعلومات عنها ظهرت ومنها تظهر كانبساط أسماء الغيوب في أصل
text.en:
- 511 -

"(al-'Alī al-Qādir al-Bāqī) then he breaks it, mixing until the first line comes out last, and writes it on pure parchment — a support for him, al-Hādī, or paper, and leaves the last line, for the last line is the first line become repeated; and he fumigates it with a good incense and carries it and increases the mention of His name al-Hādī in his standing and sitting, and at the head of every hundred says 'O Hādī — whoever seeks guidance, guide so-and-so son of so-and-so, and make him at my disposal and empower me over his forelock and his heart'; and that is on Thursday, the first hour, and he writes this square on the second face and carries it and the object is attained. And this is its figure.

[The second taksīr square — 4 columns: row 1 = 649 / 564 / 165 / 657; row 2 = 661 / 656 / 650 / 562; row 3 = 655 / 658 / 655 / 51; row 4 = 664 / 602 / 654 / 659]

And he recites over it this supplication — you say: 'O Lord, purify my clear [self] from the turbidities of the others, [purify] my attribute of Your origination, and bring me near to You and preserve me from the deficiency of the constitution, until it manifests in the mirror of my heart and touches my soul every care — imprint in the power of Jibrīl (peace be upon him), so I am strengthened by it to unveil what is in the Preserved Tablet of the secrets of Your mothers and the assemblies of Your messages — for every soul extended to it from its subtleties a side of it, and the second for who it is his, and the assemblies of these subtleties in the subtle spell of the nations, the Aware, next to the knowledge, the All-Knowing, the Marker — when the generosity that encompasses by the mouth, the heart of the revelation and the inspiration and the report and the understanding flows from me by a breath of His in this hour to its like. O my God, make me speak the greatest subtlety until I receive from You what does not fill my existence, until I delight in Your gatherings — Jibrīl rejoices in Your message. Indeed You are the Knower of the unseen — His saying is the truth, and to Him the dominion, the verse. O Hādī, O Rashīd, O Knower of the unseen, O Knower of the hidden, O Allah, O Lord of the worlds. Whoever calls by this supplication 25 times after two units of prayer, He inspires his rectitude in the worlds of the affairs — and it is the Great, the Possessor of the grand; measure by it and its measure — you find [~] for the word and the grand in its meaning, and it is a name of His great names, for the whole secret is in the speed of the answer. And suits it from the mighty verses of the Qur'ān His saying exalted 'And with Him are the keys of the unseen' to His saying 'clear.' And as for His name al-Khabīr — so whoever mentions it seven days consecutively, there comes to him the spiritual from every report he wills: the reports of the year, the reports of the kings, the reports of the absent. And as for His name the Exalted al-Mubīn — so whoever mentions it every day a thousand times in a retreat with an empty [stomach] from food and fumigates with a good incense, all the spirits incline to him, so he befriends from them what he wills and blesses what he wills — and that at the rising of the sun, and his body is set right and his temperaments balanced and his spirit elevated, and he judges by kinds of judgments no other perceives. And this is a sum of the names of Allah the Exalted: 'He is Allah, there is no god but He — al-'Alīm, al-'Allām al-Ghuyūb, al-Ḥakīm, al-Khabīr, al-Ḥāfiẓ, al-Raqīb, al-Mubīn, al-Hādī' — and they are ten names of the Essence; and the grand in them is in preserving what was hard for you to preserve. And add to them His saying 'the truth, and to Him the dominion, the verse' — and it is a mention for those opened to them the door of the nearness in the success and the knowledges, for they — whoever perseveres in its mention is inspired to glorious sciences and is addressed from his self by the languages of the inspiration, and they address him and he benefits by precise sciences, and the animal speaks to him and he understands it; and in it is a great effect in the understanding of the difficulties, and the recitation in the hour of Jupiter, for it is of the saying — the mention of the forgotten from the sciences and the preservation of all of them, and the invocations of the ancient love and the urging to preserve them and the endearment to the wise and the people of good and the crafts from the people, and gathering them upon the good. And beware that the Moon be in the inauspicious [degrees], for these names are suitable for what we mentioned, and in them is the spring of the sciences and the roots of the known from which appeared, and from them appear as the spreading of the names of the unseen in the root… [page ends, truncated]
text.id:
- 511 -

"(al-'Alī al-Qādir al-Bāqī) lalu ia memecahkan, mencampur hingga baris pertama keluar terakhir, dan menulisnya di atas kertas suci — sokongan baginya, al-Hādī, atau kertas, dan tinggalkan baris terakhir, kerana baris terakhir ialah baris pertama yang menjadi berulang; dan ia bakar dengan kemenyan baik serta memakainya dan memperbanyak dzikir nama-Nya al-Hādī dalam berdiri dan duduknya, serta di hujung tiap seratus berkata 'Wahai Hādī — siapa meminta petunjuk, berilah petunjuk si fulan bin si fulan, dan jadikan ia di bawah kuasaku serta beriku kuasa atas ubun-ubun dan hatinya'; dan itu pada Khamis, jam pertama, dan ia menulis segi empat ini di muka kedua serta memakainya dan tercapai yang dimaksud. Dan ini gambarannya.

[Segi empat taksīr kedua — 4 lajur: baris 1 = 649 / 564 / 165 / 657; baris 2 = 661 / 656 / 650 / 562; baris 3 = 655 / 658 / 655 / 51; baris 4 = 664 / 602 / 654 / 659]

Dan ia membaca atasnya doa ini — engkau ucapkan: 'Wahai Tuhan, sucikan yang jelas [diriku] dari keruh orang lain, [sucikan] sifatku dari kejadian-Mu, serta dekatkan aku kepada-Mu dan peliharaku dari kekurangan susunan, hingga ia nampak dalam cermin hatiku dan menyentuh jiwaku setiap keresahan — terapkan dalam kuasa Jibrīl a.s., maka aku dikuatkan dengannya untuk membuka apa yang dalam Lauḥ Maḥfūẓ dari rahsia ummul dan himpunan risalah-Mu — bagi tiap jiwa yang dipanjangkan kepadanya dari halusnya sisi daripadanya, dan yang kedua bagi siapa ia miliknya, serta himpunan halus ini dalam mantera halus umat, Yang Mengetahui, di sisi ilmu, Yang Maha Mengetahui, Yang Menandai — bila kemurahan yang meliputi dengan mulut, hati wahyu dan ilham serta khabar dan faham mengalir dari aku dengan hembusan-Nya pada jam ini ke serupanya. Wahai Tuhanku, jadikanlah aku berkata halus terbesar hingga aku terima dari-Mu apa yang tidak memenuhi wujudku, hingga aku bersenang dalam himpunan-Mu — Jibrīl gembira dengan risalah-Mu. Sesungguhnya Engkau Yang Mengetahui ghaib — firman-Nya benar, dan bagi-Nya kerajaan, ayat. Wahai Hādī, wahai Rashīd, wahai Yang Mengetahui ghaib, wahai Yang Mengetahui tersembunyi, ya Allah, wahai Tuhan semesta alam. Siapa berdoa dengan doa ini 25 kali selepas dua rakaat solat, Ia ilhamkan kebenarannya dalam alam urusan — dan ia Yang Agung, Pemilik keagungan; ukur dengannya dan ukurannya — engkau dapati [~] bagi kata dan keagungan dalam maknanya, dan ia nama dari nama-Nya yang agung, kerana seluruh rahsia dalam segera jawapan. Dan sesuai dengannya dari ayat agung Qur'ān firman-Nya 'Dan pada sisi-Nya kunci ghaib' hingga firman-Nya 'nyata.' Dan adapun nama-Nya al-Khabīr — barangsiapa menyebutnya tujuh hari berturut, datang kepadanya rohani dari tiap khabar dikehendaki: khabar tahun, khabar raja, khabar ghaib. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Maha Tinggi al-Mubīn — barangsiapa menyebutnya tiap hari seribu kali dalam khalwat dengan perut kosong dari makanan serta dibakar kemenyan baik, semua roh cenderung kepadanya, maka ia berkawan dari mereka apa dikehendaki dan memberkati apa dikehendaki — dan itu pada terbit matahari, serta jasadnya dibaiki dan tabiatnya seimbang dan rohnya meninggi, dan ia menghukum dengan jenis hukum tiada lain tangkap. Dan ini ringkasan nama Allah Yang Maha Tinggi: 'Ia Allah, tiada tuhan melainkan Dia — al-'Alīm, al-'Allām al-Ghuyūb, al-Ḥakīm, al-Khabīr, al-Ḥāfiẓ, al-Raqīb, al-Mubīn, al-Hādī' — dan mereka sepuluh nama Zat; dan keagungan padanya ialah memelihara apa yang sukar bagimu pelihara. Dan tambah kepada mereka firman-Nya 'yang benar, dan bagi-Nya kerajaan, ayat' — dan ia dzikir bagi yang dibukakan pintu kedekatan dalam taufik dan ilmu, kerana mereka — barangsiapa bertekun dzikirnya diilhamkan ilmu mulia dan diajak bicara dari dirinya dengan bahasa ilham, serta mereka berkata kepadanya dan ia manfaat ilmu tepat, dan haiwan berkata kepadanya serta ia faham; dan padanya kesan agung dalam faham kesulitan, serta bacaan pada jam Musytari, kerana ia dari perkataan — dzikir yang dilupakan dari ilmu dan pemeliharaan semuanya, serta doa cinta purba dan anjuran memeliharanya dan kasih pada bijak dan ahli kebaikan serta kerajinan dari manusia, dan menghimpun mereka atas kebaikan. Dan jaga agar Bulan berada dalam [darjah] tidak baik, kerana nama ini sesuai bagi apa yang kami sebut, dan padanya mata air ilmu serta akar yang diketahui yang nampak, dan daripadanya nampak sebagai penyebaran nama ghaib dalam akar… [halaman berakhir, terpotong]

title.ar: تكسير الأسماء وكتابتها على الرق الطاهر

title.id: Taksir Nama-nama dan Menulisnya pada Kertas Suci

text.ar:
- ٥١٢ -

المناجاة من عمل بها واتخذها ذكراً فتح الله تعالى عليه وسخر له العلم والفضل وأهله وحصل له بها
الكشف ويهذب منطقه ويصيب في النطق والحكمة ويرى ذاكرها عند النوم ما يسأل عنه
ويريد بيانه من الأشياء التي يريد فعلها هل هي خير أو شر فإذا أردت كشف سر من أسرار الحق
من سائر العلوم الكشفية وأجناسها يسر الله لك ذلك بالملازمة الذاكر لها ويحملها على الوجه الذي
ذكرناه من نقش أو كتابة مع ملازمة الذكر فإن جميع الأذكار كالحضور والتكرار حتى تذكر
معه عوالم ذاك الذاكر وليس ظهر ذلك في مرة أو مرتين كل بالملازمة فإن كان ولا بد من أثر
ولكن التكرار هو الأصل الذي عليه المعول ومن ذلك هذه الطائفة الشريفة في بث العلوم
الجليلة وهي أصل الأشياء ومن عمل بها واتخذها ذكراً فتح الله تعالى عليه وبورك له وسخر له أهل
العلم والفضل ويحصل له كشف أسرارها وهي ستة أسماء العليم الحكيم الخبير المبين الهادي علام
الغيوب ويناسب ذلك السحر الذي ينزل فيه أمر ربنا إلى سماء الدنيا فيقول هل من داع
فاستجيب له هل من مستغفر فأغفر له هل من سائل فأعطيه سؤله وأول الثلث الأخير الساعة التاسعة
وهي منسوبة إلى القمر وهذا دعاء خاص بصلاح القلوب وفهم العلوم من دعا به في الثلث الأخير
من الليل وتمادى عليه إلى طلوع الفجر بعد الصلاة والاستغفار وذكر الله أكبر ألهمه الله تعالى
أسباب الخير كلها بأجمعها ومن كتبه وحمله ظهرت عليه صفات الجمال وحسن الحال مالم يعهده
من نفسه قبل ذلك ومن سأل الله تعالى به ما يليق صلاح حاله وصلاح الأرواح والنفوس وفهم
العلوم وما تيسر عليه من الولاية والابتهال إلى الدين الأجل له ذلك ويظهر عليه من جميل الصفات
ما يسر به والله يقضي بالحق وهو هذا الدعاء * إلهي أسألك باسمك المكنون الذي فضلت به
فواصل التفصيل في الموجودات فتفصل كل شيء تفصيلا أظهرت في تباينه كلمة العدل فاختلفت
اللغات وظهرت الأسماء وتقابلت الأفعال وتنوعت الأنواع وتجنست الأجناس وترتبت الأفلاك
وكل ما في فلك علك بك يسبحون وبقهر عدلك يعدلون أمضى على ظلم جسمي إليك قبضا يسيرا
وابسط على نور عنايتك بسطا يسرا فأنت المتصرف المطلق أنا المتصرف المقيد حتى ألقى عنك
ويقيني مع كل ما يؤثر به بين العلوم أجمعين حتى يتقرب إلى قلبي قوالب الموجودات خاشعة أبصارها
وبصائرهم مضطرة إلى ذلك السر القهر وكل موجود بين يدي شهودي يسر معناه محكما فيه
بحكمك الذي لا يرده لا يدفع إنك تقضي بالحق ولا يقضى عليك اقضيا بالحق أنت الحق وأسماؤك
الحق وأفعالك الحق وعلمك الحق وارتباط الكل بعلمك الحق وليس إلا الحق فالحق إلى الحق من
نسبة ما أفهم حتى أعلم ما لم أكن أعلم إنك أنت علام الغيوب قوله الحق وله الملك رب قد آتيتني من
الملك وما فيه نفخ الروح من آيات القرآن يضيفها إليه وذكر القدس * واعلم أن المريخ له قوة في
المقالة والنصر واتقاء العداوة وبسرعة حتى يكاد أفعاله يزيد على قوى زحل وهي كثيرة في الفساد
وله قوة الأمراض الحارة والرمد والنزيف إذا عملت فيه فافهم ذلك ومن أسماء الله تعالى القائم
الشهيد المحصي الحليم فمن جمع الذكر إلى الآيات وسأل الله تعالى بهما أي حاجة كانت قضيت في
الوقت
text.en:
- 512 -

"The intimate converse (munājāt) — whoever works by it and takes it as a mention, Allah the Exalted opens to him and subdues for him the knowledge and the excellence and its people, and he attains by it the unveiling, and his speech is refined, and he is correct in utterance and wisdom, and the one who mentions it sees in sleep what he asks about and wills — the clarification of the things he wants to do: whether they are good or evil. So when you want to unveil a secret from the secrets of the Real from the various unveiling sciences and their kinds, Allah eases that for you by the perseverance of the one mentioning it, and he carries it upon the face that we mentioned — of engraving or writing with the perseverance of the mention — for all the invocations are like the presence and the repetition until you mention with it the worlds of that mention, and it did not appear in one or two [times] — all is by perseverance; and if there must be an effect, the repetition is the principle relied upon. And from that is this noble group in the spreading of the glorious sciences, and it is the root of things. And whoever works by it and takes it as a mention, Allah the Exalted opens to him and blesses him and subdues for him the people of knowledge and excellence, and he attains the unveiling of its secrets. And it is six names: al-'Alīm, al-Ḥakīm, al-Khabīr, al-Mubīn, al-Hādī, 'Allām al-Ghuyūb. And it suits that magic which descends in it the command of our Lord to the lowest heaven, saying 'Is there a caller, so I answer him? Is there one seeking forgiveness, so I forgive him? Is there an asker, so I give him his ask?' — and the first third of the last [portion], the ninth hour, and it is attributed to the Moon. And this is a supplication specific to the rectitude of the hearts and the understanding of the sciences — whoever calls by it in the last third of the night and persists upon it until the dawn, after the prayer and the seeking of forgiveness and the mention of 'Allah is Greatest,' Allah the Exalted inspires him all the causes of good altogether. And whoever writes it and carries it, there appear upon him the attributes of beauty and the good state such as he did not know of himself before that. And whoever asks Allah the Exalted by it what befits the rectitude of his state and the rectitude of the spirits and the souls and the understanding of the sciences and what is eased for him of the nearness (walāyah) and the devotion to the mighty religion — he has that, and there appears upon him of the beautiful attributes what gladdens him; and Allah judges by the truth. And this is the supplication: * 'O my God, I ask You by Your hidden name by which You preferred the detail of the articulation in the existents, so You articulate everything in detail — You made manifest in its difference the word of justice, so the languages differed and the names appeared and the acts opposed and the kinds varied and the species were of species and the spheres were ordered, and all that is in a sphere — by You they glorify, and by the compulsion of Your justice they are made just. Carry upon the oppression of my body toward You a gentle contraction, and spread upon [me] the light of Your care a gentle spreading — for You are the absolute disposer, and I am the limited disposer — until I cast from You and my certainty with everything that is influenced by it among all the sciences, until there draws near to my heart the molds of the existents, their gazes humbled and their insights compelled to that compelling secret; and every existent before my witness is eased in its meaning, perfected in it by Your judgment that is not turned back, not repelled. Indeed You judge by the truth, and it is not judged against You — judge by the truth; You are the Truth, and Your names are the truth, and Your acts are the truth, and Your knowledge is the truth, and the relating of all to Your knowledge the truth, and there is naught but the truth — so the truth to the truth from the relation of what I understand until I know what I did not know. Indeed You are the Knower of the unseen — His saying is the truth, and to Him the dominion. A Lord who gave me of the dominion and what is in it the breathing of the spirit from the verses of the Qur'ān that He attributes to Him, and the mention of the Holiness. * And know that Mars has a power in the speech and the victory and the averting of enmity, and with speed, until its acts almost exceed the powers of Saturn, which are many in corruption; and it has the power of the hot illnesses and the ophthalmia and the bleeding — so understand that when you work in it. And from the names of Allah the Exalted: al-Qā'im, al-Shahīd, al-Muḥṣī, al-Ḥalīm — so whoever combines the mention with the verses and asks Allah the Exalted by them, whatever need it was, it is decreed in
